switches.name: kLoadAndLaunchApp
switches.comment: Loads an app from the specified directory and launches it.

switches.name: kBackgroundThreadPoolFieldTrial
switches.comment: Configure the background threadpool field trial.

switches.name: kDisableBestEffortTasks
switches.comment: Delays execution of TaskPriority::BEST_EFFORT tasks until shutdown.

switches.name: kDisableBreakpad
switches.comment: Disables the crash reporting.

switches.name: kDisableDevShmUsage
switches.comment: The /dev/shm partition is too small in certain VM environments, causing Chrome to fail or crash (see http://crbug.com/715363). Use this flag to work-around this issue (a temporary directory will always be used to create anonymous shared memory files).

switches.name: kDisableFeatures
switches.comment: Comma-separated list of feature names to disable. See also kEnableFeatures.

switches.name: kDisableHighResTimer
switches.comment: Disable high-resolution timer on Windows.

switches.name: kDisableLowEndDeviceMode
switches.comment: Force disabling of low-end device mode when set.

switches.name: kDisableUsbKeyboardDetect
switches.comment: Disables the USB keyboard detection for blocking the OSK on Windows.

switches.name: kEnableCrashReporter
switches.comment: Indicates that crash reporting should be enabled. On platforms where helper processes cannot access to files needed to make this decision, this flag is generated internally.

switches.name: kEnableCrashReporterForTesting
switches.comment: Used for turning on Breakpad crash reporting in a debug environment where crash reporting is typically compiled but disabled.

switches.name: kEnableFeatures
switches.comment: Comma-separated list of feature names to enable. See also kDisableFeatures.

switches.name: kEnableLowEndDeviceMode
switches.comment: Force low-end device mode when set.

switches.name: kFieldTrialHandle
switches.comment: Handle to the shared memory segment containing field trial state that is to be shared between processes. The argument to this switch is made of segments separated by commas: - The platform-specific handle id for the shared memory as a string. - (Windows only) i=inherited by duplication or p=child must open parent. - The high 64 bits of the shared memory block GUID. - The low 64 bits of the shared memory block GUID. - The size of the shared memory segment as a string.

switches.name: kForceFieldTrials
switches.comment: This option can be used to force field trials when testing changes locally. The argument is a list of name and value pairs, separated by slashes. If a trial name is prefixed with an asterisk, that trial will start activated. For example, the following argument defines two trials, with the second one activated: "GoogleNow/Enable/*MaterialDesignNTP/Default/" This option can also be used by the browser process to send the list of trials to a non-browser process, using the same format. See FieldTrialList::CreateTrialsFromString() in field_trial.h for details.

switches.name: kForceHighResTimeTicks
switches.comment: Forces the use of QPC for TimeTicks even if cpuid doesn't report the presence of an invariant TSC.

switches.name: kFullMemoryCrashReport
switches.comment: Generates full memory crash dump.

switches.name: kLogBestEffortTasks
switches.comment: Logs information about all tasks posted with TaskPriority::BEST_EFFORT. Use this to diagnose issues that are thought to be caused by TaskPriority::BEST_EFFORT execution fences. Note: Tasks posted to a non-BEST_EFFORT UpdateableSequencedTaskRunner whose priority is later lowered to BEST_EFFORT are not logged.

switches.name: kMetricsSharedMemoryHandle
switches.comment: Handle to the shared memory segment a child process should use to transmit histograms back to the browser process.

switches.name: kNoErrorDialogs
switches.comment: Suppresses all error dialogs when present.

switches.name: kProfilingAtStart
switches.comment: Starts the sampling based profiler for the browser process at startup. This will only work if chrome has been built with the gn arg enable_profiling = true. The output will go to the value of kProfilingFile.

switches.name: kProfilingFile
switches.comment: Specifies a location for profiling output. This will only work if chrome has been built with the gyp variable profiling=1 or gn arg enable_profiling=true. {pid} if present will be replaced by the pid of the process. {count} if present will be incremented each time a profile is generated for this process. The default is chrome-profile-{pid} for the browser and test-profile-{pid} for tests.

switches.name: kProfilingFlush
switches.comment: Controls whether profile data is periodically flushed to a file. Normally the data gets written on exit but cases exist where chromium doesn't exit cleanly (especially when using single-process). A time in seconds can be specified.

switches.name: kTestChildProcess
switches.comment: When running certain tests that spawn child processes, this switch indicates to the test framework that the current process is a child process.

switches.name: kTraceToFile
switches.comment: Sends trace events from these categories to a file. --trace-to-file on its own sends to default categories.

switches.name: kTraceToFileName
switches.comment: Specifies the file name for --trace-to-file. If unspecified, it will go to a default file name.

switches.name: kV
switches.comment: Gives the default maximal active V-logging level; 0 is the default. Normally positive values are used for V-logging levels.

switches.name: kVModule
switches.comment: Gives the per-module maximal V-logging levels to override the value given by --v.  E.g. "my_module=2,foo*=3" would change the logging level for all code in source files "my_module.*" and "foo*.*" ("-inl" suffixes are also disregarded for this matching). Any pattern containing a forward or backward slash will be tested against the whole pathname and not just the module.  E.g., "*/foo/bar/*=2" would change the logging level for all code in source files under a "foo/bar" directory.

switches.name: kWaitForDebugger
switches.comment: Will wait for 60 seconds for a debugger to come to attach to the process.

switches.name: kForceTextDirection
switches.comment: Force the text rendering to a specific direction. Valid values are "ltr" (left-to-right) and "rtl" (right-to-left). Only tested meaningfully with RTL.

switches.name: kForceUIDirection
switches.comment: Force the UI to a specific direction. Valid values are "ltr" (left-to-right) and "rtl" (right-to-left).

switches.name: kBrowserControlsHideThreshold
switches.comment: Percentage of the browser controls need to be hidden before they will auto hide.

switches.name: kBrowserControlsShowThreshold
switches.comment: Percentage of the browser controls need to be shown before they will auto show.

switches.name: kCCLayerTreeTestLongTimeout
switches.comment: Increases timeout for memory checkers.

switches.name: kCCLayerTreeTestNoTimeout
switches.comment: Prevents the layer tree unit tests from timing out.

switches.name: kCCScrollAnimationDurationForTesting
switches.comment: Controls the duration of the scroll animation curve.

switches.name: kCheckDamageEarly
switches.comment: Checks damage early and aborts the frame if no damage, so that clients like Android WebView don't invalidate unnecessarily.

switches.name: kCompositedRenderPassBorders
switches.comment: Parameters for kUIShowCompositedLayerBorders.

switches.name: kDisableCheckerImaging
switches.comment: Disabled defering all image decodes to the image decode service, ignoring DecodingMode preferences specified on PaintImage.

switches.name: kDisableCompositedAntialiasing
switches.comment: Disables layer-edge anti-aliasing in the compositor.

switches.name: kDisableLayerTreeHostMemoryPressure
switches.comment: Disables LayerTreeHost::OnMemoryPressure

switches.name: kDisableMainFrameBeforeActivation
switches.comment: Disables sending the next BeginMainFrame before the previous commit activates. Overrides the kEnableMainFrameBeforeActivation flag.

switches.name: kDumpCompositorFrame
switches.comment: Save CompositorFrame data in both renderer and gpu process for TreesInViz and TreeAnimationsInViz. This doesn't work without --no-sandbox. If no parameters are specified, by default, it records frame 1 - 10. If --dump-compositor-frame=begin,end is specified, it records frame [begin, end] inclusive.

switches.name: kEnableClippedImageScaling
switches.comment: Allows scaling clipped images in GpuImageDecodeCache. Note that this may cause color-bleeding. TODO(crbug.com/40160880): Remove this workaround flag once the underlying cache problems are solved.

switches.name: kEnableGpuBenchmarking
switches.comment: Enables the GPU benchmarking extension

switches.name: kEnableMainFrameBeforeActivation
switches.comment: Enables sending the next BeginMainFrame before the previous commit activates.

switches.name: kLogOnUIDoubleBackgroundBlur
switches.comment: Checks and logs double background blur as an error if any.

switches.name: kNumRasterThreads
switches.comment: Controls the number of threads to use for raster tasks.

switches.name: kShowCompositedLayerBorders
switches.comment: Renders a border around compositor layers to help debug and study layer compositing.

switches.name: kShowFPSCounter
switches.comment: Draws a heads-up-display showing Frames Per Second as well as GPU memory usage. If you also use --enable-logging=stderr --vmodule="head*=1" then FPS will also be output to the console log.

switches.name: kShowLayerAnimationBounds
switches.comment: Renders a border that represents the bounding box for the layer's animation.

switches.name: kShowPropertyChangedRects
switches.comment: Show rects in the HUD around layers whose properties have changed.

switches.name: kShowScreenSpaceRects
switches.comment: Show rects in the HUD around the screen-space transformed bounds of every layer.

switches.name: kShowSurfaceDamageRects
switches.comment: Show rects in the HUD around damage as it is recorded into each render surface.

switches.name: kSlowDownRasterScaleFactor
switches.comment: Re-rasters everything multiple times to simulate a much slower machine. Give a scale factor to cause raster to take that many times longer to complete, such as --slow-down-raster-scale-factor=25.

switches.name: kAttemptFormFillingToolSkipsUI
switches.comment: Bypasses the selection of the data to be filled by the `AttemptFormFillingTool` and just picks the first suggestion for each form section. This is only intended for testing.

switches.name: kDisableActorSafetyChecks
switches.comment: Bypasses several of the actor's safety checks, such as requiring SafeBrowsing to be enabled and the blocklist. Note that some checks, like requiring https, are not affected by this.

switches.name: kSimulateUpdateErrorCode
switches.comment: Simulates a GoogleUpdateErrorCode error by the update check. Must be supplied with |kSimulateUpdateHresult| switch.

switches.name: kSimulateUpdateHresult
switches.comment: Simulates a specific HRESULT error code returned by the update check. If the switch value is not specified (as hex) then it defaults to E_FAIL.

switches.name: kAllowChromeSchemeUrl
switches.comment: Allows headless mode to access any URL whose scheme is chrome://.

switches.name: kEnableGPU
switches.comment: Enable hardware GPU support. Headless uses swiftshader by default for consistency across headless environments. This flag just turns forcing of swiftshader off and lets us revert to regular driver selection logic. Alternatively, specific drivers may be forced with --use-gl or --use-angle. Nethier approach guarantees that hardware GPU support will be enabled, as this is still conditional on headless having access to X display etc.

switches.name: kNearbyShareCertificateValidityPeriodHours
switches.comment: Overrides the default validity period for Nearby Share certificates. Value must be larger than 0.

switches.name: kNearbyShareDeviceID
switches.comment: Overrides the default device ID to provide a stable ID in test environments. By default we generate a random 10-character string.

switches.name: kNearbyShareHTTPHost
switches.comment: Overrides the default URL for Google APIs (https://www.googleapis.com) used by Nearby Share

switches.name: kNearbyShareNumPrivateCertificates
switches.comment: Overrides the default number of private certificates generated. Value must be larger than 0.

switches.name: kNearbyShareVerboseLogging
switches.comment: Enables verbose logging level for Nearby Share.

switches.name: kLoadingPredictorAllowLocalRequestForTesting
switches.comment: Allows the loading predictor to do prefetches to local IP addresses. This is needed for testing as such requests are blocked by default for security.

switches.name: kCookieRotationDelay
switches.comment: Used to add artificial delay to the cookie rotation request. It expects as value a number representing the delay in milliseconds.

switches.name: kCookieRotationResult
switches.comment: Used to simulate the cookie rotation network request response. It expects as a value a number representing the enum value of `BoundSessionRefreshCookieFetcher::Result`. Note: This should be used to simulate error cases not success. If success `0` is used, bound cookies won't be set.

switches.name: kAcceptLang
switches.comment: Can't find the switch you are looking for? Try looking in: ash/constants/ash_switches.cc base/base_switches.cc etc. When commenting your switch, please use the same voice as surrounding comments. Imagine "This switch..." at the beginning of the phrase, and it'll all work out. Specifies Accept-Language to send to servers and expose to JavaScript via the navigator.language DOM property. language[-country] where language is the 2 letter code from ISO-639.

switches.name: kAllowAppShimSignatureMismatchForTests
switches.comment: Only if we're running in an unsigned build, passing this flag will allow app shims whose code signature does not match what chrome is expecting to still connect to chrome. This is used by some tests to allow the test to pretend to be a valid app shim.

switches.name: kAllowCrossOriginAuthPrompt
switches.comment: Allows third-party content included on a page to prompt for a HTTP basic auth username/password pair.

switches.name: kAllowHttpScreenCapture
switches.comment: Allow non-secure origins to use the screen capture API and the desktopCapture extension API.

switches.name: kAllowRunningInsecureContent
switches.comment: By default, an https page cannot run JavaScript, CSS or plugins from http URLs. This provides an override to get the old insecure behavior.

switches.name: kAllowSilentPush
switches.comment: Allows Web Push notifications that do not show a notification.

switches.name: kApp
switches.comment: Specifies that the associated value should be launched in "application" mode.

switches.name: kAppId
switches.comment: Specifies that the extension-app with the specified id should be launched according to its configuration.

switches.name: kAppLaunchUrlForShortcutsMenuItem
switches.comment: Overrides the launch url of an app with the specified url. This is used along with kAppId to launch a given app with the url corresponding to an item in the app's shortcuts menu.

switches.name: kAppModeAuthCode
switches.comment: Value of GAIA auth code for --force-app-mode.

switches.name: kAppModeOAuth2Token
switches.comment: Value of OAuth2 refresh token for --force-app-mode.

switches.name: kAppRunOnOsLoginMode
switches.comment: This is used along with kAppId to indicate an app was launched during OS login, and which mode the app was launched in.

switches.name: kAppsGalleryDownloadURL
switches.comment: Overrides the URL that the webstore APIs download extensions from. Note: the URL must contain one '%s' for the extension ID.

switches.name: kAppsGalleryURL
switches.comment: Overrides the url that the browser treats as the webstore, granting it the webstore APIs and giving it some special protections.

switches.name: kAppsGalleryUpdateURL
switches.comment: Overrides the update url used by webstore extensions.

switches.name: kAppsKeepChromeAliveInTests
switches.comment: Prevents Chrome from quitting when Chrome Apps are open.

switches.name: kAuthServerAllowlist
switches.comment: Allowlist for Negotiate Auth servers

switches.name: kAutoOpenDevToolsForTabs
switches.comment: This flag makes Chrome auto-open DevTools window for each tab. It is intended to be used by developers and automation to not require user interaction for opening DevTools.

switches.name: kAutoSelectDesktopCaptureSource
switches.comment: This flag makes Chrome auto-select the provided choice when an extension asks permission to start desktop capture. Should only be used for tests. For instance, --auto-select-desktop-capture-source="Entire screen" will automatically select sharing the entire screen in English locales. The switch value only needs to be substring of the capture source name, i.e. "display" would match "Built-in display" and "External display", whichever comes first.

switches.name: kAutoSelectScreenCaptureSource
switches.comment: This flag makes Chrome auto-select any screen when an extension asks permission to start desktop capture. Should only be used for tests. kAutoSelectDesktopCaptureSource (see above) can be also be used to auto-select screens. But it have the problem that you need to know the name of a screen to auto-select it. The name of screens can't be set, are different for different platforms, and are different if you have one or several screens. So it's hard to use for auto-selecting screens. This flag does not care what the screen name is, but it also gives no control. Any screen could be chosen. It is useful in tests where we don't care which screen is auto-selected.

switches.name: kAutoSelectTabCaptureSourceByTitle
switches.comment: This flag makes Chrome auto-select a tab with the provided title when the media-picker should otherwise be displayed to the user. This switch is very similar to kAutoSelectDesktopCaptureSource, but limits selection to tabs. This solves the issue of kAutoSelectDesktopCaptureSource being liable to accidentally capturing the Chromium window instead of the tab, as both have the same title if the tab is focused.

switches.name: kAutoSelectWindowCaptureSourceByTitle
switches.comment: This flag makes Chrome auto-select a window with the provided title when the media-picker should otherwise be displayed to the user. This switch is very similar to kAutoSelectDesktopCaptureSource, but limits selection to the window.

switches.name: kBrowserSigninAutoAccept
switches.comment: Automatically signs the user into Chrome when signing in to other Google services on the web. This makes it easier for automated browsers to sign in.

switches.name: kBypassAccountAlreadyUsedByAnotherProfileCheck
switches.comment: If specified, allows syncing multiple profiles to the same account. Used for multi-client E2E tests.

switches.name: kCaptureAutoReject
switches.comment: This flag makes Chrome auto-reject requests capture a tab/window/screen.

switches.name: kCheckForUpdateIntervalSec
switches.comment: How often (in seconds) to check for updates. Should only be used for testing purposes.

switches.name: kCipherSuiteBlacklist
switches.comment: Comma-separated list of SSL cipher suites to disable.

switches.name: kCodeSignCloneCleanupProcess
switches.comment: A process type (switches::kProcessType) that cleans up the browser's temporary code sign clone.

switches.name: kCrashOnHangThreads
switches.comment: Comma-separated list of BrowserThreads that cause browser process to crash if the given browser thread is not responsive. UI/IO are the BrowserThreads that are supported. For example: --crash-on-hang-threads=UI:18,IO:18 --> Crash the browser if UI or IO is not responsive for 18 seconds while the other browser thread is responsive.

switches.name: kCreateBrowserOnStartupForTests
switches.comment: Some platforms like ChromeOS default to empty desktop. Browser tests may need to add this switch so that at least one browser instance is created on startup. TODO(nkostylev): Investigate if this switch could be removed. (http://crbug.com/148675)

switches.name: kCreateProfileEmailIfNotExists
switches.comment: If provided with kProfileEmail, prompts the user to create a new profile with kProfileEmail as the email address if that email is not found in any existing profile.

switches.name: kCredits
switches.comment: Prints licensing information (same content as found in about:credits) and quits.

switches.name: kCustomDevtoolsFrontend
switches.comment: Specifies the http:// endpoint which will be used to serve devtools://devtools/custom/<path> Or a file:// URL to specify a custom file path to load from for devtools://devtools/bundled/<path>

switches.name: kDebugPackedApps
switches.comment: Adds debugging entries such as Inspect Element to context menus of packed apps.

switches.name: kDebugPrint
switches.comment: Enables support to debug printing subsystem.

switches.name: kDevToolsFlags
switches.comment: Passes command line parameters to the DevTools front-end.

switches.name: kDiagnostics
switches.comment: Triggers a plethora of diagnostic modes.

switches.name: kDiagnosticsFormat
switches.comment: Sets the output format for diagnostic modes enabled by diagnostics flag.

switches.name: kDiagnosticsRecovery
switches.comment: Tells the diagnostics mode to do the requested recovery step(s).

switches.name: kDisableAutoReload
switches.comment: Disable auto-reload of pages on top-level error.

switches.name: kDisableBackgroundNetworking
switches.comment: Disable several subsystems which run network requests in the background. This is for use when doing network performance testing to avoid noise in the measurements.

switches.name: kDisableComponentExtensionsWithBackgroundPages
switches.comment: Disable default component extensions with background pages - useful for performance tests where these pages may interfere with perf results.

switches.name: kDisableCrashpadForTesting
switches.comment: Disables crashpad initialization for testing. The crashpad binary will not run, and thus will not detect and symbolize crashes.

switches.name: kDisableDefaultApps
switches.comment: Disables installation of default apps on first run. This is used during automated testing.

switches.name: kDisableDomainReliability
switches.comment: Disables Domain Reliability Monitoring.

switches.name: kDisableLazyLoading
switches.comment: Disables lazy loading of images and frames.

switches.name: kDisablePrintPreview
switches.comment: Disables print preview (For testing, and for users who don't like us. :[ )

switches.name: kDisablePromptOnRepost
switches.comment: Normally when the user attempts to navigate to a page that was the result of a post we prompt to make sure they want to. This switch may be used to disable that check. This switch is used during automated testing.

switches.name: kDisableStackProfiler
switches.comment: Disable stack profiling. Stack profiling may change performance. Disabling stack profiling is beneficial when comparing performance metrics with a build that has it disabled by default.

switches.name: kDisableZeroBrowsersOpenForTests
switches.comment: Some tests seem to require the application to close when the last browser window is closed. Thus, we need a switch to force this behavior for ChromeOS Aura, disable "zero window mode". TODO(pkotwicz): Investigate if this bug can be removed. (http://crbug.com/119175)

switches.name: kDiskCacheDir
switches.comment: Use a specific disk cache location, rather than one derived from the UserDatadir.

switches.name: kDiskCacheSize
switches.comment: Forces the maximum disk space to be used by the disk cache, in bytes.

switches.name: kDoNotCreateNSAppForTests
switches.comment: Skips initializing the shares NSApplication instance in ChromeTestSuite.

switches.name: kDoNotDeElevateOnLaunch
switches.comment: Do not de-elevate the browser on launch. Used after de-elevating to prevent infinite loops.

switches.name: kDumpBrowserHistograms
switches.comment: Requests that a running browser process dump its collected histograms to a given file. The file is overwritten if it exists.

switches.name: kEnableAudioDebugRecordingsFromExtension
switches.comment: If the WebRTC logging private API is active, enables audio debug recordings.

switches.name: kEnableAutoReload
switches.comment: Enable auto-reload of pages on top-level error.

switches.name: kEnableBookmarkUndo
switches.comment: Enables the multi-level undo system for bookmarks.

switches.name: kEnableCloudPrintProxy
switches.comment: This applies only when the process type is "service". Enables the Cloud Print Proxy component within the service process.

switches.name: kEnableDevToolsGreenDevUi
switches.comment: Enables the experimental GreenDev UI in DevTools.

switches.name: kEnableDomainReliability
switches.comment: Enables Domain Reliability Monitoring.

switches.name: kEnableExtensionActivityLogging
switches.comment: Enables logging for extension activity.

switches.name: kEnableHangoutServicesExtensionForTesting
switches.comment: Force enabling HangoutServicesExtension.

switches.name: kEnableNetBenchmarking
switches.comment: Enables the network-related benchmarking extensions.

switches.name: kEnablePotentiallyAnnoyingSecurityFeatures
switches.comment: Enables a number of potentially annoying security features (strict mixed content mode, powerful feature restrictions, etc.)

switches.name: kEnableProfileShortcutManager
switches.comment: Force-enables the profile shortcut manager. This is needed for tests since they use a custom-user-data-dir which disables this.

switches.name: kEnableUnsafeExtensionDebugging
switches.comment: Enables installing/uninstalling extensions at runtime via Chrome DevTools Protocol if the protocol client is connected over --remote-debugging-pipe.

switches.name: kEnableUserMetrics
switches.comment: Enable user metrics from within the installer.

switches.name: kExperimentalAiStableChannel
switches.comment: Allows experimental ai extension APIs to be used in stable channel. This disables chrome sign-in if set, regardless of channel.

switches.name: kExplicitlyAllowedPorts
switches.comment: Allows overriding the list of restricted ports by passing a comma-separated list of port numbers.

switches.name: kExtensionAiDataCollection
switches.comment: Name of the command line flag to allow the ai data collection extension API.

switches.name: kExtensionContentVerification
switches.comment: Name of the command line flag to force content verification to be on in one of various modes.

switches.name: kExtensionContentVerificationBootstrap
switches.comment: Values for the kExtensionContentVerification flag. See ContentVerifierDelegate::Mode for more explanation.

switches.name: kExtensionExperimentalActor
switches.comment: Name of the command line flag to allow the experimental actor API.

switches.name: kExtensionsToolbarZeroStateExploreExtensionsByCategory
switches.comment: This variation of the Zero State extensions toolbar recommendation suggests extension categories the user can explore in the Chrome Web Store. (e.g. find coupons, increase productivity)

switches.name: kExtensionsToolbarZeroStateSingleWebStoreLink
switches.comment: This variation of the Zero State extensions toolbar recommendation presents the user with a single link to the Chrome Web Store home page.

switches.name: kExtensionsToolbarZeroStateVariation
switches.comment: Specifies the variation of Zero State extensions toolbar recommendation to show. When a user with zero extensions installed clicks on the extensions puzzle piece in the Chrome toolbar, Chrome displays a submenu suggesting the user to explore the Chrome Web Store.

switches.name: kFocus
switches.comment: Activates an existing tab or app window by URL or app id before creating anything new. Syntax: comma-ordered selectors. Bare URLs are exact. Add a trailing * for prefix. app:<app-id> targets PWAs. Example: --focus=https://meet.google.com/*,app:abc123

switches.name: kFocusResultFile
switches.comment: Specifies a file path to write JSON focus result information.

switches.name: kForceAppMode
switches.comment: Forces application mode. This hides certain system UI elements and forces the app to be installed if it hasn't been already.

switches.name: kForceFirstRun
switches.comment: Displays the First Run experience when the browser is started, regardless of whether or not it's actually the First Run (this overrides kNoFirstRun).

switches.name: kForceNtpMobilePromo
switches.comment: Forces the NTP mobile promo to appear without any preconditions.

switches.name: kForceWhatsNew
switches.comment: Displays the What's New experience when the browser is started if it has not yet been shown for the current milestone (this overrides kNoFirstRun, without showing the First Run experience).

switches.name: kFromBrowserSwitcher
switches.comment: Indicates that this launch of the browser originated from the Legacy Browser Support for Edge extension's native host. This is recorded in UMA.

switches.name: kFromInstaller
switches.comment: Indicates that this launch of the browser originated from the installer (i.e., following a successful new install or over-install). This triggers browser behaviors for this specific launch, such as a welcome announcement for accessibility software (see https://crbug.com/1072735).

switches.name: kGlicAdminRedirectPatterns
switches.comment: List of URL patterns in the glic webview to redirect to an admin blocked panel, as a space-separated list.

switches.name: kGlicAllowedOrigins
switches.comment: List of allowed origins in the glic webview, as a space-separated list.

switches.name: kGlicAlwaysShowWebActuationToggle
switches.comment: Whether to show web actuation toggle in the Chrome AI settings page.

switches.name: kGlicAutomation
switches.comment: Automation is intended to be passed in addition to glic-dev. It further disables functionality to make basic testing easier.

switches.name: kGlicDev
switches.comment: Dev mode for glic only exposed via command line flag.

switches.name: kGlicForceG1StatusForMultiInstance
switches.comment: Override actual AI subscription tier by forcing G1 status, specifically for multi-instance enablement. Intended for manual testing only.

switches.name: kGlicGuestURL
switches.comment: Overrides the glic guest URL.

switches.name: kGlicHostLogging
switches.comment: Whether additional logging is enabled in the glic api host.

switches.name: kGlicOpenOnStartup
switches.comment: Use --glic-open-on-startup=attached or --glic-open-on-startup=detached.

switches.name: kGlicResetMultiInstanceEnabledByTier
switches.comment: Reset local state pref kGlicMultiInstanceEnabledBySubscriptionTier to false. Intended for manual testing only.

switches.name: kGlicSkipReloadAfterNavigation
switches.comment: If this flag is set, then the page navigating will not trigger a reload.

switches.name: kGuest
switches.comment: Causes the browser to launch directly in guest mode.

switches.name: kHelp
switches.comment: These flags show the man page on Linux. They are equivalent to each other.

switches.name: kHideCrashRestoreBubble
switches.comment: Does not show the crash restore bubble when the browser is started during the system startup phase in ChromeOS, if the ChromeOS full restore feature is enabled, because the ChromeOS full restore notification is shown for the user to select restore or not.

switches.name: kHideIcons
switches.comment: Makes Windows happy by allowing it to show "Enable access to this program" checkbox in Add/Remove Programs->Set Program Access and Defaults. This only shows an error box because the only way to hide Chrome is by uninstalling it.

switches.name: kHomePage
switches.comment: Specifies which page will be displayed in newly-opened tabs. We need this for testing purposes so that the UI tests don't depend on what comes up for http://google.com.

switches.name: kIgnoreProfileDirectoryIfNotExists
switches.comment: If provided with kProfileDirectory, does not create the profile if the profile directory doesn't exist.

switches.name: kIncognito
switches.comment: Causes the initial browser opened to be in incognito mode. Further browsers may or may not be in incognito mode; see `IncognitoModePrefs`.

switches.name: kInitIsolateAsForeground
switches.comment: Specifies that the main-thread Isolate should initialize in foreground mode. If not specified, the the Isolate will start in background mode for extension processes and foreground mode otherwise.

switches.name: kInstallAutogeneratedTheme
switches.comment: Installs an autogenerated theme based on the given RGB value. The format is "r,g,b", where r, g, b are a numeric values from 0 to 255.

switches.name: kInstallChromeApp
switches.comment: Causes Chrome to initiate an installation flow for the given app.

switches.name: kInstallIsolatedWebAppFromFile
switches.comment: Causes Chrome to install the unsigned Web Bundle at the given path as a developer mode Isolated Web App.

switches.name: kInstallIsolatedWebAppFromUrl
switches.comment: Causes Chrome to install a developer mode Isolated Web App whose contents are hosted at the given HTTP(S) URL.

switches.name: kInstantProcess
switches.comment: Marks a renderer as an Instant process.

switches.name: kKeepAliveForTest
switches.comment: Used for testing - keeps browser alive after last browser window closes.

switches.name: kKioskMode
switches.comment: Enable kiosk mode. Please note this is not Chrome OS kiosk mode.

switches.name: kKioskModePrinting
switches.comment: Enable automatically pressing the print button in print preview.

switches.name: kListApps
switches.comment: Writes open and installed web apps for each profile to the specified file without launching a new browser window or tab. Pass a absolute file path to specify where to output the information. Can be used together with optional --profile-base-name switch to only write information for a given profile.

switches.name: kMakeChromeDefault
switches.comment: Indicates whether Chrome should be set as the default browser during installation.

switches.name: kMakeDefaultBrowser
switches.comment: Makes Chrome default browser

switches.name: kMetricsClientID
switches.comment: This is how the metrics client ID is passed from the browser process to its children. With Crashpad, the metrics client ID is distinct from the crash client ID.

switches.name: kMonitoringDestinationID
switches.comment: Allows setting a different destination ID for connection-monitoring GCM messages. Useful when running against a non-prod management server.

switches.name: kNativeMessagingConnectExtension
switches.comment: Requests a native messaging connection be established between the extension with ID specified by this switch and the native messaging host named by the kNativeMessagingConnectHost switch.

switches.name: kNativeMessagingConnectHost
switches.comment: Requests a native messaging connection be established between the native messaging host named by this switch and the extension with ID specified by kNativeMessagingConnectExtension.

switches.name: kNativeMessagingConnectId
switches.comment: If set when kNativeMessagingConnectHost and kNativeMessagingConnectExtension are specified, is reflected to the native messaging host as a command line parameter.

switches.name: kNoDefaultBrowserCheck
switches.comment: Disables the default browser check. Useful for UI/browser tests where we want to avoid having the default browser info-bar displayed.

switches.name: kNoExperiments
switches.comment: Disables all experiments set on about:flags. Does not disable about:flags itself. Useful if an experiment makes chrome crash at startup: One can start chrome with --no-experiments, disable the problematic lab at about:flags and then restart chrome without this switch again.

switches.name: kNoFirstRun
switches.comment: Skip First Run tasks as well as not showing additional dialogs, prompts or bubbles. Suppressing dialogs, prompts, and bubbles is important as this switch is used by automation (including performance benchmarks) where it's important only a browser window is shown. This may not actually be the first run or the What's New page. Its effect can be partially ignored by adding kForceFirstRun (for FRE), kForceWhatsNew (for What's New) and/or kIgnoreNoFirstRunForSearchEngineChoiceScreen (for the DSE choice screen). This does not drop the First Run sentinel and thus doesn't prevent first run from occurring the next time chrome is launched without this flag. It also does not update the last What's New milestone, so does not prevent What's New from occurring the next time chrome is launched without this flag.

switches.name: kNoNetworkProfileWarning
switches.comment: Whether or not the browser should warn if the profile is on a network share. This flag is only relevant for Windows currently.

switches.name: kNoPings
switches.comment: Don't send hyperlink auditing pings

switches.name: kNoPreReadMainDll
switches.comment: Whether this process should PrefetchVirtualMemory on the contents of Chrome.dll. This warms up the pages in memory to speed up startup but might not be required in later renderers and/or GPU. For experiment info see crbug.com/1350257.

switches.name: kNoProxyServer
switches.comment: Don't use a proxy server, always make direct connections. Overrides any other proxy server flags that are passed.

switches.name: kNoServiceAutorun
switches.comment: Disables the service process from adding itself as an autorun process. This does not delete existing autorun registrations, it just prevents the service from registering a new one.

switches.name: kNoStartupWindow
switches.comment: Does not automatically open a browser window on startup (used when launching Chrome for the purpose of hosting background apps).

switches.name: kNotificationInlineReply
switches.comment: Used in combination with kNotificationLaunchId to specify the inline reply entered in the toast in the Windows Action Center.

switches.name: kNotificationLaunchId
switches.comment: Used for launching Chrome when a toast displayed in the Windows Action Center has been activated. Should contain the launch ID encoded by Chrome.

switches.name: kOnTheFlyMhtmlHashComputation
switches.comment: Calculate the hash of an MHTML file as it is being saved. The browser process will write the serialized MHTML contents to a file and calculate its hash as it is streamed back from the renderer via a Mojo data pipe.

switches.name: kOpenInNewWindow
switches.comment: Launches URL in new browser window.

switches.name: kPackExtension
switches.comment: Packages an extension to a .crx installable file from a given directory.

switches.name: kPackExtensionKey
switches.comment: Optional PEM private key to use in signing packaged .crx.

switches.name: kPreCrashpadCrashTest
switches.comment: Causes the browser process to crash very early in startup, just before crashpad (or breakpad) is initialized.

switches.name: kPredictionServiceMockLikelihood
switches.comment: Used to mock the response received from the Web Permission Prediction Service. Used for testing.

switches.name: kPreinstalledWebAppsDir
switches.comment: A directory where Chrome looks for json files describing default/preinstalled web apps. This overrides any default directory to load preinstalled web apps from.

switches.name: kPrivetIPv6Only
switches.comment: Use IPv6 only for privet HTTP.

switches.name: kProductVersion
switches.comment: Outputs the product version information and quit. Used as an internal api to detect the installed version of Chrome on Linux.

switches.name: kProfileBaseName
switches.comment: Pass the basename of the profile directory to specify which profile to get information. Only relevant when used with --list-apps switch.

switches.name: kProfileDirectory
switches.comment: Selects directory of profile to associate with the first browser launched.

switches.name: kProfileEmail
switches.comment: Like kProfileDirectory, but selects the profile by email address. If the email is not found in any existing profile, this switch has no effect. If both kProfileDirectory and kProfileEmail are specified, kProfileDirectory takes priority.

switches.name: kProfileManagementAttributes
switches.comment: Domains and associated SAML attributes for which third-party profile management should be enabled. Input should be in JSON format.

switches.name: kProxyAutoDetect
switches.comment: Forces proxy auto-detection.

switches.name: kProxyBypassList
switches.comment: Specifies a list of hosts for whom we bypass proxy settings and use direct connections. Ignored if --proxy-auto-detect or --no-proxy-server are also specified. This is a comma-separated list of bypass rules. See: "net/proxy_resolution/proxy_host_matching_rules.h" for the format of these rules.

switches.name: kProxyPacUrl
switches.comment: Uses the pac script at the given URL

switches.name: kProxyServer
switches.comment: Uses a specified proxy server, overrides system settings.

switches.name: kPwaLauncherVersion
switches.comment: Specifies the version of the Progressive-Web-App launcher that launched Chrome, used to determine whether to update all launchers. NOTE: changing this switch requires adding legacy handling for the previous method, as older PWA launchers still using this switch will rely on Chrome to update them to use the new method.

switches.name: kRefreshPlatformPolicy
switches.comment: Forces immediate platform policy refresh (not cloud policy) when Chrome is already running. The switch prevents a new browser window from opening and only triggers the policy refresh. Useful for testing and automation to avoid waiting for the next scheduled refresh interval. No-op if Chrome is not already running.

switches.name: kRelauncherProcess
switches.comment: A process type (switches::kProcessType) that relaunches the browser. See chrome/browser/mac/relauncher.h.

switches.name: kRelauncherProcessDMGDevice
switches.comment: When switches::kProcessType is switches::kRelauncherProcess, if this switch is also present, the relauncher process will unmount and eject a mounted disk image and move its disk image file to the trash.  The argument's value must be a BSD device name of the form "diskN" or "diskNsM".

switches.name: kRemoteDebuggingTargets
switches.comment: Provides a list of addresses to discover DevTools remote debugging targets. The format is <host>:<port>,...,<host>:port.

switches.name: kRepairAllValidExtensions
switches.comment: Indicates that all corrupted extensions should be repaired if they are are enabled by policy. This is mainly used after a user data downgrade.

switches.name: kRestart
switches.comment: Indicates that Chrome was restarted (e.g., after a flag change). This is used to ignore the launch when recording the Launch.Mode2 metric.

switches.name: kRestoreLastSession
switches.comment: Indicates the last session should be restored on startup. This overrides the preferences value. Note that this does not force automatic session restore following a crash, so as to prevent a crash loop. This switch is used to implement support for OS-specific "continue where you left off" functionality on OS X and Windows.

switches.name: kSSLVersionMax
switches.comment: Specifies the maximum SSL/TLS version ("tls1.2" or "tls1.3").

switches.name: kSSLVersionMin
switches.comment: Specifies the minimum SSL/TLS version ("tls1.2" or "tls1.3").

switches.name: kSSLVersionTLSv12
switches.comment: TLS 1.2 mode for |kSSLVersionMax| and |kSSLVersionMin| switches.

switches.name: kSSLVersionTLSv13
switches.comment: TLS 1.3 mode for |kSSLVersionMax| and |kSSLVersionMin| switches.

switches.name: kSameTab
switches.comment: Indicates that the URL in the command line should open in the active tab instead of a new tab. In case of multiple URLS given as arguments, the first one will replace the active tab.

switches.name: kShowIcons
switches.comment: See kHideIcons.

switches.name: kSilentDebuggerExtensionAPI
switches.comment: Does not show an infobar when an extension attaches to a page using chrome.debugger page. Required to attach to extension background pages.

switches.name: kSilentLaunch
switches.comment: Causes Chrome to launch without opening any windows by default. Useful if one wishes to use Chrome as an ash server.

switches.name: kSimulateBrowsingDataLifetime
switches.comment: Sets the BrowsingDataLifetime policy to a very short value (shorter than normally possible) for testing purposes.

switches.name: kSimulateCriticalUpdate
switches.comment: Simulates a critical update being available.

switches.name: kSimulateElevatedRecovery
switches.comment: Simulates that elevation is needed to recover upgrade channel.

switches.name: kSimulateIdleTimeout
switches.comment: Sets the IdleTimeout policy to a very short value (shorter than normally possible) for testing purposes.

switches.name: kSimulateOutdated
switches.comment: Simulates that current version is outdated.

switches.name: kSimulateOutdatedNoAU
switches.comment: Simulates that current version is outdated and auto-update is off.

switches.name: kSimulateUpgrade
switches.comment: Simulates an update being available.

switches.name: kSourceAppId
switches.comment: When rendezvousing with an existing process, used to indicate that the StartupInfoW of the new Chrome process had dwFlags == STARTF_TITLEISAPPID. This is used to record launch metrics.

switches.name: kSourceShortcut
switches.comment: When rendezvousing with an existing process, used to pass the path of the shortcut that launched the new Chrome process. This is used to record launch metrics.

switches.name: kStartMaximized
switches.comment: Starts the browser maximized, regardless of any previous settings.

switches.name: kStartStackProfiler
switches.comment: Starts the stack sampling profiler in the child process.

switches.name: kStartStackProfilerBrowserTest
switches.comment: Browser test mode for the |kStartStackProfiler| switch. Limits the profile durations to be significantly less than the test timeout. On ChromeOS, forces the stack sampling profiler to run on all processes as well.

switches.name: kStoragePressureNotificationInterval
switches.comment: Interval, in minutes, used for storage pressure notification throttling. Useful for developers testing applications that might use non-trivial amounts of disk space.

switches.name: kSystemAudioCaptureDefaultChecked
switches.comment: This flag sets the checkboxes for sharing system audio during window or screen capture to on by default. It is primarily intended to be used for tests.

switches.name: kSystemLogUploadFrequency
switches.comment: Frequency in Milliseconds for system log uploads. Should only be used for testing purposes.

switches.name: kTabCaptureAudioDefaultUnchecked
switches.comment: This flag sets the checkboxes for sharing audio during tab capture to off by default. It is primarily intended to be used for tests.

switches.name: kTestMemoryLogDelayInMinutes
switches.comment: Custom delay for memory log. This should be used only for testing purpose.

switches.name: kTestName
switches.comment: Passes the name of the current running automated test to Chrome.

switches.name: kThisTabCaptureAutoAccept
switches.comment: These flags make Chrome auto-accept/reject requests to capture the current tab. It should only be used for tests.

switches.name: kTrustedDownloadSources
switches.comment: Identifies a list of download sources as trusted, but only if proper group policy is set.

switches.name: kUninstall
switches.comment: Runs un-installation steps that were done by chrome first-run.

switches.name: kUninstallAppId
switches.comment: Specifies that the WebApp with the specified id should be uninstalled.

switches.name: kUniqueTempDirSuffix
switches.comment: When switches::kProcessType is switches::kCodeSignCloneCleanupProcess this switch is required. The value must be the unique suffix portion of the temporary directory that contains the clone. The full path will be reconstructed by the cleanup process.

switches.name: kUnlimitedStorage
switches.comment: Overrides per-origin quota settings to unlimited storage for any apps/origins.  This should be used only for testing purpose.

switches.name: kUnsafelyDisableDevToolsSelfXssWarnings
switches.comment: Disables warnings about self-XSS attacks when pasting into the DevTools console.

switches.name: kUseSystemProxyResolver
switches.comment: Uses WinHttp to resolve proxies instead of using Chromium's normal proxy resolution logic. This is only supported in Windows. TODO(crbug.com/40111093): Only use WinHttp whenever Chrome is exclusively using system proxy configs.

switches.name: kUserDataDir
switches.comment: Specifies the user data directory, which is where the browser will look for all of its state.

switches.name: kUserDataMigrated
switches.comment: Indicates that this process is the product of a relaunch following migration of User Data.

switches.name: kValidateCrx
switches.comment: Examines a .crx for validity and prints the result.

switches.name: kVersion
switches.comment: Prints version information and quits.

switches.name: kWebRtcIPHandlingPolicy
switches.comment: Override WebRTC IP handling policy to mimic the behavior when WebRTC IP handling policy is specified in Preferences.

switches.name: kWebRtcRemoteEventLogProactivePruningDelta
switches.comment: Sets the delay (in seconds) between proactive prunings of remote-bound WebRTC event logs which are pending upload. All positive values are legal. All negative values are illegal, and ignored. If set to 0, the meaning is "no proactive pruning".

switches.name: kWebRtcRemoteEventLogUploadDelayMs
switches.comment: WebRTC event logs will only be uploaded if the conditions hold for this many milliseconds.

switches.name: kWebRtcRemoteEventLogUploadNoSuppression
switches.comment: Normally, remote-bound WebRTC event logs are uploaded only when no peer connections are active. With this flag, the upload is never suppressed.

switches.name: kWinHttpProxyResolver
switches.comment: Uses WinHTTP to fetch and evaluate PAC scripts. Otherwise the default is to use Chromium's network stack to fetch, and V8 to evaluate.

switches.name: kWinJumplistAction
switches.comment: Specifies which category option was clicked in the Windows Jumplist that resulted in a browser startup.

switches.name: kWindowName
switches.comment: Specify the initial window user title: --window-name="My custom title"

switches.name: kWindowPosition
switches.comment: Specify the initial window position: --window-position=x,y

switches.name: kWindowSize
switches.comment: Specify the initial window size: --window-size=w,h

switches.name: kWindowWorkspace
switches.comment: Specify the initial window workspace: --window-workspace=id

switches.name: kWmClass
switches.comment: The same as the --class argument in X applications.  Overrides the WM_CLASS window property with the given value.

switches.name: kAlsoEmitSuccessLogs
switches.comment: Also emit full event trace logs for successful tests.

switches.name: kDevtoolsCodeCoverage
switches.comment: Directory to output JavaScript code coverage. When supplied enables coverage in selected browser tests.

switches.name: kPerfTestPrintUmaMeans
switches.comment: Show the mean value of histograms that native performance tests are monitoring. Note that this is only applicable for PerformanceTest subclasses.

switches.name: kLogFileHandle
switches.comment: A switch conveying a handle value for the file to which the service should emit its logs.

switches.name: kLogFileSource
switches.comment: A switch conveying the PID of the process in which the log file handle value is valid.

switches.name: kUnattendedTest
switches.comment: A switch that indicates that the service is running on behalf of an unattended test (i.e., one for which CHROME_HEADLESS is set in its environment block).

switches.name: kAutofillAPIKey
switches.comment: Sets the API key that will be used when calling Autofill API instead of using Chrome's baked key by default. You can use this to test new versions of the API that are not linked to the Chrome baked key yet.

switches.name: kAutofillServerURL
switches.comment: Override the default autofill server URL with "scheme://host[:port]/prefix/".

switches.name: kAutofillUploadThrottlingPeriodInDays
switches.comment: The number of days after which to reset the registry of autofill events for which an upload has been sent.

switches.name: kIgnoreAutocompleteOffForAutofill
switches.comment: Ignores autocomplete="off" for Autofill data (profiles + credit cards).

switches.name: kShowAutofillSignatures
switches.comment: Annotates forms and fields with Autofill signatures.

switches.name: kShowAutofillTypePredictions
switches.comment: Annotates forms with Autofill field type predictions.

switches.name: kWalletServiceUseSandbox
switches.comment: Use the sandbox Online Wallet service URL (for developer testing).

switches.name: kDisableSyncInvalidationOptimizations
switches.comment: Disables the optimizations flags in Commit requests for sync invalidations. This is useful for live tests to avoid flakiness.

switches.name: kEnableLocalSyncBackend
switches.comment: Enabled the local sync backend implemented by the LoopbackServer.

switches.name: kLocalSyncBackendDir
switches.comment: Specifies the local sync backend directory. The name is chosen to mimic user-data-dir etc. This flag only matters if the enable-local-sync-backend flag is present.

switches.name: kCastStreamingReceiverPort
switches.comment: If set, allows to use a specific UDP port for Cast Streaming sessions on the receiver side. Otherwise the Cast Streaming receiver is using a random system port.

switches.name: kInitializeClientHintsStorage
switches.comment: Pre-load the client hint storage. Takes a JSON dict, with each key being an origin (RFC 6454 Section 6.2) and each value a comma-separated list of client hint tokens (RFC 8942 Section 3.1, client-hints-infrastructure Section 7.1). Each origin/token-list entry will be parsed and persisted to the Client Hints storage as though the token-list had come through an Accept-CH response header from a navigation from the origin. The initialization will only apply to non-OffTheRecord profiles, meaning incognito or guest profiles will not have the storage applied.

switches.name: kCampaignsTestTag
switches.comment: Switch to control which serving campaigns file versions to select in test cohort. Example: `--campaigns-test-tag=dev1` will select test cohort which tag matches dev1.

switches.name: kComponentUpdater
switches.comment: Comma-separated options to troubleshoot the component updater. Only valid for the browser process.

switches.name: kComponentUpdaterTrustTokensComponentPath
switches.comment: Optional testing override of the Trust Tokens key commitment component's path.

switches.name: kDemoModeTestTag
switches.comment: Switch to control which serving demo mode app versions to select in test cohort. Example: `--demo-app-test-tag=dev1` will select test cohort which tag matches dev1.

switches.name: kCrashpadHandler
switches.comment: A process type (switches::kProcessType) that indicates chrome.exe or setup.exe is being launched as crashpad_handler. This is only used on Windows. We bundle the handler into chrome.exe on Windows because there is high probability of a "new" .exe being blocked or interfered with by application firewalls, AV software, etc. On other platforms, crashpad_handler is a standalone executable.

switches.name: kCrashpadHandlerPid
switches.comment: The process ID of the Crashpad handler.

switches.name: kDataSharingDebugLoggingEnabled
switches.comment: Switch for whether or not data sharing logs are stored at startup instead of only being stored/logged when chrome://data-sharing-internals is open.

switches.name: kDisablePopupBlocking
switches.comment: Disables pop-up blocking.

switches.name: kHeadless
switches.comment: Enable headless mode.

switches.name: kOriginTrialDisabledFeatures
switches.comment: Contains a list of feature names for which origin trial experiments should be disabled. Names should be separated by "|" characters.

switches.name: kOriginTrialDisabledTokens
switches.comment: Contains a list of token signatures for which origin trial experiments should be disabled. Tokens should be separated by "|" characters.

switches.name: kOriginTrialPublicKey
switches.comment: Comma-separated list of keys which will override the default public keys for checking origin trial tokens.

switches.name: kShortReportingDelay
switches.comment: Sets the Reporting API delay to under a second to allow much quicker reports.

switches.name: kUseMobileUserAgent
switches.comment: Set when Chromium should use a mobile user agent.

switches.name: kUserAgent
switches.comment: A string used to override the default user agent with a custom one.

switches.name: kDisableDinosaurEasterEgg
switches.comment: Disables the dinosaur easter egg on the offline interstitial.

switches.name: kEnableDinosaurEasterEggAltGameImages
switches.comment: Enable the dinosaur easter egg alternative images.

switches.name: kFeedbackServer
switches.comment: Alternative feedback server to use when submitting user feedback

switches.name: kGoogleBaseURL
switches.comment: Specifies an alternate URL to use for speaking to Google. Useful for testing.

switches.name: kIgnoreGooglePortNumbers
switches.comment: When set, this will ignore the PortPermission passed in the google_util.h methods and ignore the port numbers. This makes it easier to run tests for features that use these methods (directly or indirectly) with the EmbeddedTestServer, which is more representative of production.

switches.name: kDefaultBackgroundColor
switches.comment: The background color to be used if the page doesn't specify one. Provided as RGB or RGBA integer value in hex, e.g. 'ff0000ff' for red or '00000000' for transparent.

switches.name: kDisablePDFTagging
switches.comment: Do not emit tags when printing PDFs.

switches.name: kDumpDom
switches.comment: Print the serialized DOM (doctype + document.documentElement.outerHTML) to stdout.

switches.name: kGeneratePDFDocumentOutline
switches.comment: Embed the document outline into printed PDFs.

switches.name: kNoPDFHeaderFooter
switches.comment: Do not display header and footer in the printed PDF file.

switches.name: kPrintToPDF
switches.comment: Save a PDF file of the loaded page.

switches.name: kScreenshot
switches.comment: Save a screenshot of the loaded page.

switches.name: kTimeout
switches.comment: Issues a stop after the specified number of milliseconds.  This cancels all navigation and causes the DOMContentLoaded event to fire.

switches.name: kVirtualTimeBudget
switches.comment: If set the system waits the specified number of virtual milliseconds before deeming the page to be ready.  For determinism virtual time does not advance while there are pending network fetches (i.e no timers will fire). Once all network fetches have completed, timers fire and if the system runs out of virtual time is fastforwarded so the next timer fires immediately, until the specified virtual time budget is exhausted.

switches.name: kSubprocessHeapProfiling
switches.comment: Forces Heap Profiling on for a subprocess. The browser will add this when the subprocess should be profiled.

switches.name: kDisableHangMonitor
switches.comment: Suppresses hang monitor dialogs in renderer processes.  This may allow slow unload handlers on a page to prevent the tab from closing, but the Task Manager can be used to terminate the offending process in this case.

switches.name: kDisablePinch
switches.comment: Disables compositor-accelerated touch-screen pinch gestures.

switches.name: kValidateInputEventStream
switches.comment: In debug builds, asserts that the stream of input events is valid.

switches.name: kExportUmaLogsToFile
switches.comment: Enables the observing of all UMA logs created during the session and automatically exports them to the passed file path on shutdown (the file is created if it does not already exist). This also enables viewing all UMA logs in the chrome://metrics-internals debug page. The format of the exported file is outlined in MetricsServiceObserver::ExportLogsAsJson(). Example usage: --export-uma-logs-to-file=/tmp/logs.json

switches.name: kForceEnableMetricsReporting
switches.comment: Forces metrics reporting to be enabled. Should not be used for tests as it will send data to servers.

switches.name: kForceMsbbSettingOnForUkm
switches.comment: Forces MSBB setting to be on for UKM recording. Should only be used in automated testing browser sessions in which it is infeasible or impractical to toggle the setting manually.

switches.name: kMetricsRecordingOnly
switches.comment: Enables the recording of metrics reports but disables reporting. In contrast to kForceEnableMetricsReporting, this executes all the code that a normal client would use for reporting, except the report is dropped rather than sent to the server. This is useful for finding issues in the metrics code during UI and performance tests.

switches.name: kMetricsUploadIntervalSec
switches.comment: Override the standard time interval between each metrics report upload for UMA and UKM. It is useful to set to a short interval for debugging. Unit in seconds. (The default is 1800 seconds on desktop).

switches.name: kResetVariationState
switches.comment: Forces a reset of the one-time-randomized FieldTrials on this client, also known as the Chrome Variations state.

switches.name: kUkmServerUrl
switches.comment: Overrides the URL of the server that UKM reports are uploaded to. This can only be used in debug builds.

switches.name: kUmaInsecureServerUrl
switches.comment: Overrides the URL of the server that UMA reports are uploaded to when the connection to the default secure URL fails (see |kUmaServerUrl|). This can only be used in debug builds.

switches.name: kUmaServerUrl
switches.comment: Overrides the URL of the server that UMA reports are uploaded to. This can only be used in debug builds.

switches.name: kEnableHttp2GreaseSettings
switches.comment: `kEnableHttp2GreaseSettings` does not include the word "enable" for historical reasons.

switches.name: kEnableNTPSearchEngineCountryDetection
switches.comment: Enables using the default search engine country to show country specific popular sites on the NTP.

switches.name: kEnableModelQualityDogfoodLogging
switches.comment: Enables model quality logs regardless of other client-side settings, as long as the client is a dogfood client.

switches.name: kFetchHintsOverride
switches.comment: Overrides scheduling and time delays for fetching hints and causes a hints fetch immediately on start up using the provided comma separate lists of hosts.

switches.name: kFetchHintsOverrideTimer
switches.comment: Overrides the hints fetch scheduling and delay, causing a hints fetch immediately on start up using the TopHostProvider. This is meant for testing.

switches.name: kGoogleApiKeyConfigurationCheckOverride
switches.comment: Enables overriding Google API key configuration check for permissions.

switches.name: kHintsProtoOverride
switches.comment: Overrides the Hints Protobuf that would come from the component updater. If the value of this switch is invalid, regular hint processing is used. The value of this switch should be a base64 encoding of a binary Configuration message, found in optimization_guide's hints.proto. Providing a valid value to this switch causes Chrome startup to block on hints parsing.

switches.name: kModelExecutionEnableRemoteDebugLogging
switches.comment: Adds header to indicate to return debug logging data from the model execution service via response header.

switches.name: kModelExecutionValidate
switches.comment: Triggers validation of the server-side AI model execution. Used for integration testing.

switches.name: kModelOverride
switches.comment: Disables the fetching of models and overrides the file path and metadata to be used for the session to use what's passed via command-line instead of what is already stored. We expect that the string be a comma-separated string of model overrides with each model override be: OPTIMIZATION_TARGET_STRING:file_path or OPTIMIZATION_TARGET_STRING:file_path:base64_encoded_any_proto_model_metadata. It is possible this only works on Desktop since file paths are less easily accessible on Android, but may work.

switches.name: kModelQualityServiceAPIKey
switches.comment: Overrides the ModelQuality Service API Key for remote requests to be made.

switches.name: kModelQualityServiceURL
switches.comment: Overrides the model quality service URL.

switches.name: kModelValidate
switches.comment: Triggers validation of the model. Used for manual testing.

switches.name: kOnDeviceModelAdaptationsOverride
switches.comment: Overrides the on-device model adaptation file paths for on-device model execution.

switches.name: kOnDeviceModelExecutionOverride
switches.comment: Overrides the on-device model file paths for on-device model execution.

switches.name: kOnDeviceValidationRequestOverride
switches.comment: Enables the on-device model to run validation at startup after a delay. A text file can be provided used as input for the validation job and an output file path can be provided to write the response to.

switches.name: kOptimizationGuideLanguageOverride
switches.comment: Allows sending an language code to the backend.

switches.name: kOptimizationGuideServiceAPIKey
switches.comment: Overrides the Optimization Guide Service API Key for remote requests to be made.

switches.name: kOptimizationGuideServiceGetHintsURL
switches.comment: Overrides the Optimization Guide Service URL that the HintsFetcher will request remote hints from.

switches.name: kOptimizationGuideServiceGetModelsURL
switches.comment: Overrides the Optimization Guide Service URL that the PredictionModelFetcher will request remote models and host features from.

switches.name: kOptimizationGuideServiceModelExecutionURL
switches.comment: Overrides the Optimization Guide model execution URL.

switches.name: kPurgeHintsStore
switches.comment: Purges the store containing fetched and component hints on startup, so that it's guaranteed to be using fresh data.

switches.name: kPurgeModelAndFeaturesStore
switches.comment: Purges the store containing prediction medels and host model features on startup, so that it's guaranteed to be using fresh data.

switches.name: kUseMockKeychain
switches.comment: Uses mock keychain for testing purposes, which prevents blocking dialogs from causing timeouts.

switches.name: kPageContentAnnotationsSkipFCPWaitForTesting
switches.comment: If enabled, page content annotations requests will not wait for FCP.

switches.name: kPageContentAnnotationsValidationContentVisibility
switches.comment: Enables the specific annotation type to run validation at startup after a delay. A comma separated list of inputs can be given as a value which will be used as input for the validation job.

switches.name: kPageContentAnnotationsValidationWriteToFile
switches.comment: Writes the output of page content annotation validations to the given file.

switches.name: kEnableEncryptionSelection
switches.comment: Enables the feature of allowing the user to disable the backend via a setting.

switches.name: kEnableShareButtonUnbranded
switches.comment: Enables Password Sharing button in password details UI in settings when running unbranded builds.

switches.name: kPasswordStore
switches.comment: Specifies which encryption storage backend to use. Possible values are kwallet, kwallet5, kwallet6, gnome-libsecret, basic. Any other value will lead to Chrome detecting the best backend automatically.

switches.name: kPasswordChangeUrl
switches.comment: This switch allows testing password change feature on provided URL. Password change will be offered by submitting password form on any URL with matching eTLD+1.

switches.name: kDenyPermissionPrompts
switches.comment: Prevents permission prompts from appearing by denying instead of showing prompts.

switches.name: kChromePolicy
switches.comment: Set policy value by command line.

switches.name: kDeviceManagementUrl
switches.comment: Specifies the URL at which to communicate with the device management backend to fetch configuration policies and perform other device tasks.

switches.name: kEncryptedReportingUrl
switches.comment: Specifies the URL at which to upload encrypted reports.

switches.name: kFileStorageServerUploadUrl
switches.comment: Specifies the URL at which to communicate with File Storage Server (go/crosman-file-storage-server) to upload log and support packet files.

switches.name: kPolicyVerificationKey
switches.comment: Replace the original verification_key with the one provided by the command line flag. Can be used only for unit tests or browser tests.

switches.name: kRealtimeReportingUrl
switches.comment: Specifies the URL at which to upload real-time reports.

switches.name: kSecureConnectApiUrl
switches.comment: Specifies the base URL to contact the secure connect Api.

switches.name: kDefaultListCountryOverride
switches.comment: Special value for the `kSearchEngineChoiceCountry` command-line flag. Enables the Waffle program and overrides the list of search engines to display the default set.

switches.name: kEeaListCountryOverride
switches.comment: Special value for the `kSearchEngineChoiceCountry` command-line flag. Enables the Waffle program and overrides the list of search engines to display the list of all EEA engines.

switches.name: kSearchEngineChoiceCountry
switches.comment: Overrides the profile country (which is among other things used for search engine choice region checks for example). Intended for testing. Parameter can be one of 3 things: - 2-letter country codes => Will override the profile country - A program name => Will override the country and the program - A specific list override => Will override the program, but instead of overriding the country, will use special values to force the search engine list to some preset testing ones.

switches.name: kTaiyakiProgramOverride
switches.comment: Special value for the `kSearchEngineChoiceCountry` command-line flag. Enables the Taiyaki program. On unsupported platform / build types, will fall back to default program / unknown country.

switches.name: kArtificialCachedEnterpriseBlockedVerdictFlag
switches.comment: Command-line flag for caching an artificial blocked enterprise lookup verdict.

switches.name: kArtificialCachedEnterpriseWarnedVerdictFlag
switches.comment: Command-line flag for caching an artificial flagged enterprise lookup verdict.

switches.name: kArtificialCachedHashPrefixRealTimeVerdictFlag
switches.comment: Command-line flag for caching an artificial phishing verdict for hash-prefix real-time lookups.

switches.name: kArtificialCachedPhishGuardVerdictFlag
switches.comment: Command-line flag for caching an artificial PhishGuard unsafe verdict.

switches.name: kArtificialCachedUrlRealTimeVerdictFlag
switches.comment: Command-line flag for caching an artificial phishing verdict for URL real-time lookups.

switches.name: kCsdDebugFeatureDirectoryFlag
switches.comment: Command-line flag that can be used to write extracted CSD features to disk. This is also enables a few other behaviors that are useful for debugging.

switches.name: kMarkAsHighConfidenceAllowlisted
switches.comment: List of comma-separated URLs to mark as present on the high-confidence allowlist.

switches.name: kMarkAsMalware
switches.comment: List of comma-separated URLs to mark as malware for local database checks.

switches.name: kMarkAsPasswordProtectionAllowlisted
switches.comment: List of comma-separated URLs to mark as present on the password protection allowlist. Note this uses the client-side detection allowlist.

switches.name: kMarkAsPhishing
switches.comment: List of comma-separated URLs to mark as phishing for local database checks.

switches.name: kMarkAsUws
switches.comment: List of comma-separated URLs to mark as unwanted software for local database checks.

switches.name: kOverrideCsdModelFlag
switches.comment: Command-line flag that can be used to override the current CSD model. Must be provided with an absolute path.

switches.name: kSbEnableEnhancedProtection
switches.comment: Enable Safe Browsing Enhanced Protection.

switches.name: kSbManualDownloadBlocklist
switches.comment: List of comma-separated sha256 hashes of executable files which the download-protection service should treat as "dangerous."  For a file to show a warning, it also must be considered a dangerous filetype and not be allowlisted otherwise (by signature or URL) and must be on a supported OS. Hashes are in hex. This is used for manual testing when looking for ways to by-pass download protection.

switches.name: kScamDetectionKeyboardLockTriggerAndroid
switches.comment: Enable the keyboard lock trigger of Scam Detection via command line for easier testing.

switches.name: kSkipCSDAllowlistOnPreclassification
switches.comment: If present, indicates that the client-side detection allowlist check should be skipped (it is treated as no match).

switches.name: kSkipHighConfidenceAllowlist
switches.comment: If the switch is present, any high-confidence allowlist check will return that it does not match the allowlist.

switches.name: kUrlFilteringEndpointFlag
switches.comment: Alternate URL to use for ChromeEnterpriseRealTimeUrlLookupService real-time lookups.

switches.name: kWpMaxParallelActiveRequests
switches.comment: The command line flag to control the max amount of concurrent active requests.

switches.name: kDisableSearchEngineChoiceScreen
switches.comment: Disable the search engine choice screen for testing / autmation.

switches.name: kExtraSearchQueryParams
switches.comment: Additional query params to insert in the search and instant URLs.  Useful for testing.

switches.name: kForceSearchEngineChoiceScreen
switches.comment: Force-enable showing the search engine choice screen for testing regardless of region or choice already having been made.

switches.name: kIgnoreNoFirstRunForSearchEngineChoiceScreen
switches.comment: Override the --no-first-run dialog suppression for the search dialog for testing

switches.name: kSearchEngineChoiceNoRepromptString
switches.comment: The string that's passed to `switches::kSearchEngineChoiceTriggerRepromptParams` so that we don't reprompt users with the choice screen.

switches.name: kGoogleDoodleUrl
switches.comment: Overrides the URL used to fetch the current Google Doodle. Example: https://www.google.com/async/ddljson Testing? Try: https://www.gstatic.com/chrome/ntp/doodle_test/ddljson_android0.json https://www.gstatic.com/chrome/ntp/doodle_test/ddljson_android1.json https://www.gstatic.com/chrome/ntp/doodle_test/ddljson_android2.json https://www.gstatic.com/chrome/ntp/doodle_test/ddljson_android3.json https://www.gstatic.com/chrome/ntp/doodle_test/ddljson_android4.json

switches.name: kSearchProviderLogoURL
switches.comment: Use a static URL for the logo of the default search engine. Example: https://www.google.com/branding/logo.png

switches.name: kThirdPartyDoodleURL
switches.comment: Overrides the Doodle URL to use for third-party search engines. Testing? Try: https://www.gstatic.com/chrome/ntp/doodle_test/third_party_simple.json https://www.gstatic.com/chrome/ntp/doodle_test/third_party_animated.json

switches.name: kClearTokenService
switches.comment: Clears the token service before using it. This allows simulating the expiration of credentials during testing.

switches.name: kForceFreDefaultBrowserStep
switches.comment: Force enable the default browser step in the first run experience on Desktop.

switches.name: kDisableSync
switches.comment: Disables syncing browser data to a Google Account.

switches.name: kSyncDeferredStartupTimeoutSeconds
switches.comment: Allows overriding the deferred init fallback timeout.

switches.name: kSyncIncludeSpecificsInProtocolLog
switches.comment: Controls whether the initial state of the "Capture Specifics" flag on chrome://sync-internals is enabled.

switches.name: kSyncProtocolLogBufferSize
switches.comment: Controls the number of ProtocolEvents that are buffered, and thus can be displayed on newly-opened chrome://sync-internals tabs.

switches.name: kSyncServiceURL
switches.comment: Overrides the default server used for profile sync.

switches.name: kSyncShortInitialRetryOverride
switches.comment: This flag causes sync to retry very quickly (see polling_constants.h) the when it encounters an error, as the first step towards exponential backoff.

switches.name: kSyncShortNudgeDelayForTest
switches.comment: This flag significantly shortens the delay between nudge cycles. Its primary purpose is to speed up integration tests. The normal delay allows coalescing and prevention of server overload, so don't use this unless you're really sure that it's what you want.

switches.name: kInitializeMojoAsBroker
switches.comment: Used by some tests to force Mojo broker initialization in a spawned child process.

switches.name: kBackgroundTracingOutputPath
switches.comment: Sets a local folder destination for tracing data. This is only used if kEnableBackgroundTracing is also specified.

switches.name: kDefaultTraceBufferSizeLimitInKb
switches.comment: This is only used when we did not set buffer size in trace config and will be used for all trace sessions. If not provided, we will use the default value provided in perfetto_config.cc

switches.name: kEnableBackgroundTracing
switches.comment: Enables background tracing by passing a scenarios config as an argument. The config is a serialized proto `perfetto.protos.ChromeFieldTracingConfig` defined in third_party/perfetto/protos/perfetto/config/chrome/scenario_config.proto. protoc can be used to generate a serialized proto config with protoc --encode=perfetto.protos.ChromeFieldTracingConfig --proto_path=third_party/perfetto/ third_party/perfetto/protos/perfetto/config/chrome/scenario_config.proto < {input txt config}.pbtxt > {output proto config}.pb

switches.name: kEnableTracingOutput
switches.comment: Similar to the flag above, with the following differences: - A more detailed basename will be generated. - If the value is empty or ends with path separator, the provided directory will be used (with empty standing for current directory) and a detailed basename file will be generated. It is ignored if --trace-startup-file is specified.

switches.name: kPerfettoDisableInterning
switches.comment: Repeat internable data for each TraceEvent in the perfetto proto format.

switches.name: kTraceBufferHandle
switches.comment: Handle to the shared memory segment a child process should use to transmit tracing data back to the tracing service. This flag allows tracing to be recorded before sandbox setup.

switches.name: kTraceConfigFile
switches.comment: Enables startup tracing by passing a file path containing the chrome Json tracing config as an argument. This flag will be ignored if --trace-startup is provided.

switches.name: kTraceConfigHandle
switches.comment: Causes TRACE_EVENT flags to be recorded from startup, passing a SMB handle containing the serialized perfetto config. This flag will be ignored if --trace-startup is provided.

switches.name: kTracePerfettoConfigFile
switches.comment: Enables startup tracing by passing a file path containing the perfetto config as an argument. The config is a serialized or base64 encoded proto `perfetto.protos.TraceConfig` defined in third_party/perfetto/protos/perfetto/config/trace_config.proto. This flag will be ignored if --trace-startup is provided.

switches.name: kTraceProcessTrackUuid
