switches.comment: Child process track uuid used by perfetto; this is chosen by the browser process and sent to child processes to get predictable track uuid.

switches.name: kTraceSmbSize
switches.comment: Configures the size of the shared memory buffer used for tracing. Value is provided in kB. Defaults to 4096. Should be a multiple of the SMB page size (currently 32kB on Desktop or 4kB on Android).

switches.name: kTraceStartup
switches.comment: Causes TRACE_EVENT flags to be recorded from startup. Optionally, can specify the specific trace categories to include (e.g. --trace-startup=base,net) otherwise, all events are recorded. Setting this flag results in the first call to BeginTracing() to receive all trace events since startup. Historically, --trace-startup was used for browser startup profiling and --enable-tracing was used for browsertest tracing. Now they are share the same implementation, but both are still supported to avoid disrupting existing workflows. The only difference between them is the default duration (5 seconds for trace-startup, unlimited for enable-tracing). If both are specified, 'trace-startup' takes precedence. In Chrome, you may find --trace-startup-file and --trace-startup-duration to control the auto-saving of the trace (not supported in the base-only TraceLog component).

switches.name: kTraceStartupDuration
switches.comment: Sets the time in seconds until startup tracing ends. If omitted: - if --trace-startup is specified, a default of 5 seconds is used. - if --enable-tracing is specified, tracing lasts until the browser is closed. Has no effect otherwise.

switches.name: kTraceStartupFile
switches.comment: If supplied, sets the file which startup tracing will be stored into, if omitted the default will be used "chrometrace.log" in the current directory. Has no effect unless --trace-startup is also supplied. Example: --trace-startup --trace-startup-file=/tmp/trace_event.log As a special case, can be set to 'none' - this disables automatically saving the result to a file and the first manually recorded trace will then receive all events since startup.

switches.name: kTraceStartupFormat
switches.comment: Sets the output format for the trace, valid values are "json" and "proto". If not set, the current default is "proto". "proto", unlike json, supports writing the trace into the output file incrementally and is more likely to retain more data if the browser process unexpectedly terminates. Ignored if "trace-startup-owner" is not "controller".

switches.name: kTraceStartupOwner
switches.comment: Specifies the coordinator of the startup tracing session. If the legacy tracing backend is used instead of perfetto, providing this flag is not necessary. Valid values: 'controller', 'devtools', or 'system'. Defaults to 'controller'. If 'controller' is specified, the session is controlled and stopped via the TracingController (e.g. to implement the timeout). If 'devtools' is specified, the startup tracing session will be owned by DevTools and thus can be controlled (i.e. stopped) via the DevTools Tracing domain on the first session connected to the browser endpoint. If 'system' is specified, the system Perfetto service should already be tracing on a supported platform (currently only Android). Session is stopped through the normal methods for stopping system traces.

switches.name: kTraceStartupRecordMode
switches.comment: If supplied, sets the tracing record mode and options; otherwise, the default "record-until-full" mode will be used.

switches.name: kTranslateRankerModelURL
switches.comment: Overrides the URL from which the translate ranker model is downloaded.

switches.name: kTranslateScriptURL
switches.comment: Overrides the default server used for Google Translate.

switches.name: kTranslateSecurityOrigin
switches.comment: Overrides security-origin with which Translate runs in an isolated world.

switches.name: kTrustedVaultServiceURLSwitch
switches.comment: Specifies the vault server used for trusted vault passphrase.

switches.name: kEnableUiDevTools
switches.comment: Enables DevTools server for UI (mus, ash, etc). Value should be the port the server is started on. Default port is 9223.

switches.name: kAcceptEmptySeedSignatureForTesting
switches.comment: Accept an empty signature when loading a variations seed. This is for testing purposes.

switches.name: kDisableFieldTrialTestingConfig
switches.comment: Disable field trial tests configured in fieldtrial_testing_config.json.

switches.name: kDisableVariationsSafeMode
switches.comment: Disable variations safe mode.

switches.name: kDisableVariationsSeedFetch
switches.comment: Disable fetching of variations seed from the server for testing.

switches.name: kDisableVariationsSeedFetchThrottling
switches.comment: Disables throttling for fetching the variations seed on mobile platforms. The seed will be fetched on startup and every time the app enters the foreground, regardless of the time passed in between the fetches. On Desktop, this switch has no effect (the seed is fetched periodically instead).

switches.name: kEnableBenchmarking
switches.comment: TODO(asvitkine): Consider removing or renaming this functionality. See flag_descriptions.cc for more details.

switches.name: kEnableBenchmarkingApi
switches.comment: Enables the benchmarking JavaScript API.

switches.name: kEnableFieldTrialTestingConfig
switches.comment: Enable field trial tests configured in fieldtrial_testing_config.json. If the "disable_fieldtrial_testing_config" GN flag is set to true, then this switch is a no-op. Otherwise, for non-Chrome branded builds, the testing config is already applied by default, unless the "--disable-field-trial-config", "--force-fieldtrials", and/or "--variations-server-url" switches are passed. It is however possible to apply the testing config as well as specify additional field trials (using "--force-fieldtrials") by using this switch. For Chrome-branded builds, the testing config is not enabled by default, so this switch is required to enable it.

switches.name: kEnableFinchSeedDeltaCompression
switches.comment: Enables delta-compression when fetching a new seed via the "first run" code path on Android.

switches.name: kFakeVariationsChannel
switches.comment: Fakes the channel of the browser for purposes of Variations filtering. This is to be used for testing only. Possible values are "stable", "beta", "dev" and "canary". This works for official builds as well.

switches.name: kForceDisableVariationIds
switches.comment: Forces to remove Chrome Variation Ids from being sent in X-Client-Data header, specified as a 64-bit encoded list of numeric experiment ids. Ids prefixed with the character "t" will be treated as Trigger Variation Ids.

switches.name: kForceFieldTrialParams
switches.comment: This option can be used to force parameters of field trials when testing changes locally. The argument is a param list of (key, value) pairs prefixed by an associated (trial, group) pair. You specify the param list for multiple (trial, group) pairs with a comma separator. Example: "Trial1.Group1:k1/v1/k2/v2,Trial2.Group2:k3/v3/k4/v4" Trial names, groups names, parameter names, and value should all be URL escaped for all non-alphanumeric characters.

switches.name: kForceVariationIds
switches.comment: Forces additional Chrome Variation Ids that will be sent in X-Client-Data header, specified as a 64-bit encoded list of numeric experiment ids. Ids prefixed with the character "t" will be treated as Trigger Variation Ids. IMPORTANT: You can use this switch for test purposes (e.g. a manual command line run or from a unit test), but NOT for production code in the browser, as the latter is not allowed for privacy reasons (except for the current use by about:flags code).

switches.name: kVariationsInsecureServerURL
switches.comment: Specifies a custom URL for the server to use as an insecure fallback when requests to |kVariationsServerURL| fail. Requests to this URL will be encrypted.

switches.name: kVariationsOverrideCountry
switches.comment: Allows overriding the country used for evaluating variations. This is similar to the "Override Variations Country" entry on chrome://translate-internals, but is exposed as a command-line flag to allow testing First Run scenarios. Additionally, unlike chrome://translate-internals, the value isn't persisted across sessions.

switches.name: kVariationsSeedCorpus
switches.comment: Specifies the value of the variations seed corpus to use. When unspecified or unrecognized, the default corpus will be used.

switches.name: kVariationsSeedFetchInterval
switches.comment: Override the time interval between each variation seed fetches. Unit is in minutes. The minimum is 1 minute. The default is 30 minutes.

switches.name: kVariationsSeedVersion
switches.comment: Used to share variations seed version with child processes.

switches.name: kVariationsServerURL
switches.comment: Specifies a custom URL for the server which reports variation data to the client. Specifying this switch enables the Variations service on unofficial builds. See variations_service.cc.

switches.name: kVariationsStateFile
switches.comment: Use features defined in the value. Use this flag to reproduce experiments related issues. Copy 'Command-line Variations' value from chrome://version page. Save it to a file and pass it via this flag. The value is a base64 encoded JSON format produced by `variations::VariationsCommandLine::WriteToString`.

switches.name: kVariationsTestSeedJsonPath
switches.comment: Specifies the location of a seed file for Local State's seed to be populated from. The seed file must be in json format with the keys |kVariationsCompressedSeed| and |kVariationsSeedSignature|.

switches.name: kDeadlineToSynchronizeSurfaces
switches.comment: The default number of the BeginFrames to wait to activate a surface with dependencies.

switches.name: kDelegatedInkRenderer
switches.comment: Force the use of a Delegated Ink renderer as specified by the command line argument, rather than using system details. Acceptable values are: skia, system, none. Default to skia.

switches.name: kDisableAdpf
switches.comment: Disables reporting of frame timing via ADPF, even if supported on the device.

switches.name: kDisableFrameRateLimit
switches.comment: Disables begin frame limiting in both cc scheduler and display scheduler. Also implies --disable-gpu-vsync (see //ui/gl/gl_switches.h). TODO(ananta/jonross/sunnyps) http://crbug.com/346931323 We should remove or change this once VRR support is implemented for Windows and other platforms potentially.

switches.name: kDoubleBufferCompositing
switches.comment: Sets the number of max pending frames in the GL buffer queue to 1.

switches.name: kEnableHardwareOverlays
switches.comment: Enable compositing individual elements via hardware overlays when permitted by device. Setting the flag to "single-fullscreen" will try to promote a single fullscreen overlay and use it as main framebuffer where possible.

switches.name: kRunAllCompositorStagesBeforeDraw
switches.comment: Effectively disables pipelining of compositor frame production stages by waiting for each stage to finish before completing a frame.

switches.name: kShowAggregatedDamage
switches.comment: Adds a DebugBorderDrawQuad to the top of the root RenderPass showing the damage rect after surface aggregation. Note that when enabled this feature sets the entire output rect as damaged after adding the quad to highlight the real damage rect, which could hide damage rect problems.

switches.name: kShowDCLayerDebugBorders
switches.comment: Show debug borders for DC layers - red for overlays and blue for underlays. The debug borders are offset from the layer rect by a few pixels for clarity.

switches.name: kTintCompositedContentModulate
switches.comment: Modulates the debug compositor tint color so that damage and page flip updates are made clearly visible. This feature was useful in determining the root cause of https://b.corp.google.com/issues/183260320 . The tinting flag "tint-composited-content" must also be enabled for this flag to used.

switches.name: kFlagSwitchesBegin
switches.comment: These two flags are added around the switches about:flags adds to the command line. This is useful to see which switches were added by about:flags on about:version. They don't have any effect.

switches.name: kAllowCommandLinePlugins
switches.comment: Allows plugins to be loaded in the command line for testing.

switches.name: kAllowFileAccessFromFiles
switches.comment: By default, file:// URIs cannot read other file:// URIs. This is an override for developers who need the old behavior for testing.

switches.name: kAllowInsecureLocalhost
switches.comment: Enables TLS/SSL errors on localhost to be ignored (no interstitial, no blocking of requests).

switches.name: kAllowLoopbackInPeerConnection
switches.comment: Allows loopback interface to be added in network list for peer connection.

switches.name: kAttributionReportingDebugMode
switches.comment: Causes the Attribution Report API to run without delays or noise.

switches.name: kAudioProcessHighPriority
switches.comment: Use high priority for the audio process.

switches.name: kAutoAcceptCameraAndMicrophoneCapture
switches.comment: Bypasses the dialog prompting the user for permission to capture cameras and microphones. Useful in automatic tests of video-conferencing Web applications. This is nearly identical to kUseFakeUIForMediaStream, with the exception being that this flag does NOT affect screen-capture.

switches.name: kBrowserCrashTest
switches.comment: Causes the browser process to crash on startup.

switches.name: kBrowserStartupDialog
switches.comment: Causes the browser process to display a dialog on launch.

switches.name: kBrowserSubprocessPath
switches.comment: Path to the exe to run for the renderer and plugin subprocesses.

switches.name: kChangeStackGuardOnFork
switches.comment: After a zygote forks a new process, change the stack canary. This switch is useful so not all forked processes use the same canary (a secret value), which can be vulnerable to information leaks and brute force attacks. See https://crbug.com/1206626. This requires that all functions on the stack at the time content::RunZygote() is called be compiled without stack canaries. Valid values are "enable" or "disable".

switches.name: kDeviceScaleFactor
switches.comment: Device scale factor passed to certain processes like renderers, etc.

switches.name: kDisable2dCanvasAntialiasing
switches.comment: Disable antialiasing on 2d canvas.

switches.name: kDisable2dCanvasClipAntialiasing
switches.comment: Disable antialiasing on 2d canvas clips

switches.name: kDisable2dCanvasImageChromium
switches.comment: Disables Canvas2D rendering into a scanout buffer for overlay support.

switches.name: kDisable3DAPIs
switches.comment: Disables client-visible 3D APIs, in particular WebGL. This is controlled by policy and is kept separate from the other enable/disable switches to avoid accidentally regressing the policy support for controlling access to these APIs.

switches.name: kDisableAccelerated2dCanvas
switches.comment: Disable gpu-accelerated 2d canvas.

switches.name: kDisableAcceleratedVideoDecode
switches.comment: Disables hardware acceleration of video decode, where available. Warning: do not remove or rename this flag, as it is used inside ChromeOS code to implement the DeviceHardwareVideoDecodingEnabled policy.

switches.name: kDisableAcceleratedVideoEncode
switches.comment: Disables hardware acceleration of video encode, where available.

switches.name: kDisableBackForwardCache
switches.comment: Disables the BackForwardCache feature.

switches.name: kDisableBackgroundTimerThrottling
switches.comment: Disable task throttling of timer tasks from background pages.

switches.name: kDisableBackgroundingOccludedWindowsForTesting
switches.comment: Disable backgrounding renders for occluded windows. Done for tests to avoid nondeterministic behavior.

switches.name: kDisableBackingStoreLimit
switches.comment: Disable limits on the number of backing stores. Can prevent blinking for users with many windows/tabs and lots of memory.

switches.name: kDisableBlinkFeatures
switches.comment: Disable one or more Blink runtime-enabled features. Use names from runtime_enabled_features.json5, separated by commas. Applied after kEnableBlinkFeatures, and after other flags that change these features.

switches.name: kDisableDomainBlockingFor3DAPIs
switches.comment: Disable the per-domain blocking for 3D APIs after GPU reset. This switch is intended only for tests.

switches.name: kDisableFileSystem
switches.comment: Disable FileSystem API.

switches.name: kDisableGestureRequirementForPresentation
switches.comment: Disable user gesture requirement for presentation.

switches.name: kDisableGpu
switches.comment: Disables GPU hardware acceleration.  If software renderer is not in place, then the GPU process won't launch.

switches.name: kDisableGpuCompositing
switches.comment: Prevent the compositor from using its GPU implementation.

switches.name: kDisableGpuEarlyInit
switches.comment: Disable proactive early init of GPU process.

switches.name: kDisableGpuMemoryBufferCompositorResources
switches.comment: Do not force that all compositor resources be backed by GPU memory buffers.

switches.name: kDisableGpuMemoryBufferVideoFrames
switches.comment: Disable GpuMemoryBuffer backed VideoFrames.

switches.name: kDisableGpuProcessCrashLimit
switches.comment: For tests, to disable the limit on the number of times the GPU process may be restarted.

switches.name: kDisableGpuWatchdog
switches.comment: Disable the thread that crashes the GPU process if it stops responding to messages.

switches.name: kDisableHistogramCustomizer
switches.comment: Disable the RenderThread's HistogramCustomizer.

switches.name: kDisableIgnoreDuplicateNavsForTesting
switches.comment: Disables the IgnoreDuplicateNavs feature. This prevent navigations from being unintentionally ignored in tests.

switches.name: kDisableInProcessStackTraces
switches.comment: Disables the in-process stack traces.

switches.name: kDisableIpcFloodingProtection
switches.comment: Disables the IPC flooding protection. It is activated by default. Some javascript functions can be used to flood the browser process with IPC. This protection limits the rate at which they can be used.

switches.name: kDisableJavaScriptHarmonyShipping
switches.comment: Disable latest shipping ECMAScript 6 features.

switches.name: kDisableKillAfterBadIPC
switches.comment: Don't kill a child process when it sends a bad IPC message.  Apart from testing, it is a bad idea from a security perspective to enable this switch.

switches.name: kDisableLCDText
switches.comment: Disables LCD text.

switches.name: kDisableLegacyIntermediateWindow
switches.comment: Disable the Legacy Window which corresponds to the size of the WebContents.

switches.name: kDisableLocalStorage
switches.comment: Disable LocalStorage.

switches.name: kDisableLogging
switches.comment: Force logging to be disabled.  Logging is enabled by default in debug builds.

switches.name: kDisableLowLatencyDxva
switches.comment: Disables using CODECAPI_AVLowLatencyMode when creating DXVA decoders.

switches.name: kDisableMojoBroker
switches.comment: Disables Mojo broker capabilities in the browser during Mojo initialization.

switches.name: kDisableNewContentRenderingTimeout
switches.comment: Disables clearing the rendering output of a renderer when it didn't commit new output for a while after a top-frame navigation.

switches.name: kDisableNotifications
switches.comment: Disables the Web Notification and the Push APIs.

switches.name: kDisableNv12DxgiVideo
switches.comment: Disables the video decoder from drawing to an NV12 textures instead of ARGB.

switches.name: kDisableOriginTrialControlledBlinkFeatures
switches.comment: Disables all RuntimeEnabledFeatures that can be enabled via OriginTrials.

switches.name: kDisablePlatformAccessibilityIntegration
switches.comment: Disables the activation of browser and web accessibility via interactions with the platform's accessibility integration (i.e., a screenreader will not be able to function with the browser).

switches.name: kDisablePresentationAPI
switches.comment: Disables the Presentation API.

switches.name: kDisablePushStateThrottle
switches.comment: Disables throttling of history.pushState/replaceState calls.

switches.name: kDisableReadingFromCanvas
switches.comment: Taints all <canvas> elements, regardless of origin.

switches.name: kDisableRemoteFonts
switches.comment: Disables remote web font support. SVG font should always work whether this option is specified or not.

switches.name: kDisableRemotePlaybackAPI
switches.comment: Disables the RemotePlayback API.

switches.name: kDisableRendererBackgrounding
switches.comment: Prevent renderer process backgrounding when set.

switches.name: kDisableResourceScheduler
switches.comment: Whether the ResourceScheduler is disabled.  Note this is only useful for C++ Headless embedders who need to implement their own resource scheduling.

switches.name: kDisableScrollToTextFragment
switches.comment: This switch disables the ScrollToTextFragment feature.

switches.name: kDisableSharedWorkers
switches.comment: Disable shared workers.

switches.name: kDisableSiteIsolation
switches.comment: Disables site isolation. Note that the opt-in (to site-per-process, isolate-origins, etc.) via enterprise policy and/or cmdline takes precedence over the kDisableSiteIsolation switch (i.e. the opt-in takes effect despite potential presence of kDisableSiteIsolation switch). Note that for historic reasons the name of the switch misleadingly mentions "trials", but the switch also disables the default site isolation that ships on desktop since M67.  The name of the switch is preserved for backcompatibility of chrome://flags.

switches.name: kDisableSkiaRuntimeOpts
switches.comment: Do not use runtime-detected high-end CPU optimizations in Skia.  This is useful for forcing a baseline code path for e.g. web tests.

switches.name: kDisableSmoothScrolling
switches.comment: Disable smooth scrolling for testing.

switches.name: kDisableSoftwareCompositingFallback
switches.comment: For tests, to disable falling back to software compositing if the GPU Process has crashed, and reached the GPU Process crash limit.

switches.name: kDisableSoftwareRasterizer
switches.comment: Disables the use of a 3D software rasterizer.

switches.name: kDisableSpeechAPI
switches.comment: Disables the Web Speech API (both speech recognition and synthesis).

switches.name: kDisableSpeechSynthesisAPI
switches.comment: Disables the speech synthesis part of Web Speech API.

switches.name: kDisableThreadedCompositing
switches.comment: Disable multithreaded GPU compositing of web content.

switches.name: kDisableV8IdleTasks
switches.comment: Disable V8 idle tasks.

switches.name: kDisableWebGL
switches.comment: Disable all versions of WebGL.

switches.name: kDisableWebGL2
switches.comment: Disable WebGL2.

switches.name: kDisableWebGLImageChromium
switches.comment: Disables WebGL rendering into a scanout buffer for overlay support.

switches.name: kDisableWebRtcEncryption
switches.comment: Disables encryption of RTP Media for WebRTC. When Chrome embeds Content, it ignores this switch on its stable and beta channels.

switches.name: kDisableWebSecurity
switches.comment: Don't enforce the same-origin policy; meant for website testing only. This switch has no effect unless --user-data-dir (as defined by the content embedder) is also present.

switches.name: kDisableYUVImageDecoding
switches.comment: Disable YUV image decoding for those formats and cases where it's supported. Has no effect unless GPU rasterization is enabled.

switches.name: kDisableZeroCopyDxgiVideo
switches.comment: Disable the video decoder from drawing directly to a texture.

switches.name: kDisallowV8FeatureFlagOverrides
switches.comment: Disallows overriding of v8 feature flags.

switches.name: kDomAutomationController
switches.comment: Specifies if the |DOMAutomationController| needs to be bound in the renderer. This binding happens on per-frame basis and hence can potentially be a performance bottleneck. One should only enable it when automating dom based tests.

switches.name: kEnableAggressiveDOMStorageFlushing
switches.comment: Enable the aggressive flushing of DOM Storage to minimize data loss.

switches.name: kEnableAutomation
switches.comment: Enable indication that browser is controlled by automation.

switches.name: kEnableBlinkFeatures
switches.comment: Enable one or more Blink runtime-enabled features. Use names from runtime_enabled_features.json5, separated by commas. Applied before kDisableBlinkFeatures, and after other flags that change these features.

switches.name: kEnableBlinkTestFeatures
switches.comment: Enables blink runtime enabled features with status:"test" or status:"experimental", which are enabled when running web tests.

switches.name: kEnableCanvas2DLayers
switches.comment: Enable in-progress canvas 2d API methods BeginLayer and EndLayer.

switches.name: kEnableCaretBrowsing
switches.comment: Enable native caret browsing, in which a moveable cursor is placed on a web page, allowing a user to select and navigate through non-editable text using just a keyboard. See https://crbug.com/977390 for links to i2i.

switches.name: kEnableExperimentalCookieFeatures
switches.comment: Flag that turns on a group of experimental/newly added cookie-related features together, as a convenience for e.g. testing, to avoid having to set multiple switches individually which may be error-prone (not to mention tedious). There is not a corresponding switch to disable all these features, because that is discouraged, and for testing purposes you'd need to switch them off individually to identify the problematic feature anyway. At present this turns on: net::features::kSameSiteDefaultChecksMethodRigorously net::features::kCookieSameSiteConsidersRedirectChain net::features::kEnablePortBoundCookies net::features::kEnableSchemeBoundCookies

switches.name: kEnableExperimentalWebAssemblyFeatures
switches.comment: Enables experimental WebAssembly features.

switches.name: kEnableExperimentalWebPlatformFeatures
switches.comment: Enables Web Platform features that are in development.

switches.name: kEnableGpuMemoryBufferVideoFrames
switches.comment: Enable GpuMemoryBuffer backed VideoFrames.

switches.name: kEnableIsolatedWebAppsInRenderer
switches.comment: Enables Isolated Web Apps (IWAs) in a renderer process. There are two ways to enable the IWAs: by feature flag and by enterprise policy. If IWAs are enabled by any of the mentioned above ways then this flag is passed to the renderer process. This flag should not be used from command line. To enable IWAs from command line one should use kIsolatedWebApps feature flag.

switches.name: kEnableLCDText
switches.comment: Enables LCD text.

switches.name: kEnableLogging
switches.comment: Force logging to be enabled.  Logging is disabled by default in release builds.

switches.name: kEnableNetworkInformationDownlinkMax
switches.comment: Enables the type, downlinkMax attributes of the NetInfo API. Also, enables triggering of change attribute of the NetInfo API when there is a change in the connection type.

switches.name: kEnablePluginPlaceholderTesting
switches.comment: Enables testing features of the Plugin Placeholder. For internal use only.

switches.name: kEnablePreciseMemoryInfo
switches.comment: Make the values returned to window.performance.memory more granular and more up to date in shared worker. Without this flag, the memory information is still available, but it is bucketized and updated less frequently. This flag also applys to workers.

switches.name: kEnablePrivacySandboxAdsApis
switches.comment: Enables Privacy Sandbox APIs: Attribution Reporting, Fledge, Topics, Fenced Frames, Shared Storage, Private Aggregation, and their associated features.

switches.name: kEnableServiceBinaryLauncher
switches.comment: If true the ServiceProcessLauncher is used to launch services. This allows for service binaries to be loaded rather than using the utility process. This is only useful for tests.

switches.name: kEnableSkiaBenchmarking
switches.comment: Enables the Skia benchmarking extension.

switches.name: kEnableSmoothScrolling
switches.comment: On platforms that support it, enables smooth scroll animation.

switches.name: kEnableSpatialNavigation
switches.comment: Enable spatial navigation

switches.name: kEnableSpeechDispatcher
switches.comment: Allows sending text-to-speech requests to speech-dispatcher, a common Linux speech service. Because it's buggy, the user must explicitly enable it so that visiting a random webpage can't cause instability.

switches.name: kEnableStrictMixedContentChecking
switches.comment: Blocks all insecure requests from secure contexts, and prevents the user from overriding that decision.

switches.name: kEnableStrictPowerfulFeatureRestrictions
switches.comment: Blocks insecure usage of a number of powerful features (device orientation, for example) that we haven't yet deprecated for the web at large.

switches.name: kEnableTracingFraction
switches.comment: When specified along with a value in the range (0,1] will --enable-tracing for (roughly) that percentage of tests being run. This is done in a stable manner such that the same tests are chosen each run, and under the assumption that tests hash equally across the range of possible values. The flag will enable all tracing categories for those tests, and none for the rest. This flag could be used with other tracing switches like --enable-tracing-format, but any other switches that will enable tracing will turn tracing on for all tests.

switches.name: kEnableUserMediaScreenCapturing
switches.comment: Enable screen capturing support for MediaStream API.

switches.name: kEnableViewport
switches.comment: Enables the use of the @viewport CSS rule, which allows pages to control aspects of their own layout. This also turns on touch-screen pinch gestures.

switches.name: kEnableVtune
switches.comment: Enable the Vtune profiler support.

switches.name: kEnableWebGLDeveloperExtensions
switches.comment: Enables WebGL developer extensions which are not generally exposed to the web platform.

switches.name: kEnableWebGLDraftExtensions
switches.comment: Enables WebGL extensions not yet approved by the community.

switches.name: kEnableWebGLImageChromium
switches.comment: Enables WebGL rendering into a scanout buffer for overlay support.

switches.name: kFileUrlPathAlias
switches.comment: Define an alias root directory which is replaced with the replacement string in file URLs. The format is "/alias=/replacement", which would turn file:///alias/some/path.html into file:///replacement/some/path.html.

switches.name: kFontCacheSharedHandle
switches.comment: DirectWrite FontCache is shared by browser to renderers using shared memory. This switch allows us to pass the shared memory handle to the renderer.

switches.name: kForcePresentationReceiverForTesting
switches.comment: This forces pages to be loaded as presentation receivers.  Useful for testing behavior specific to presentation receivers. Spec: https://www.w3.org/TR/presentation-api/#interface-presentationreceiver

switches.name: kForceWebRtcIPHandlingPolicy
switches.comment: Override WebRTC IP handling policy to mimic the behavior when WebRTC IP handling policy is specified in Preferences.

switches.name: kGpu2StartupDialog
switches.comment: Causes the second GPU process used for gpu info collection to display a dialog on launch.

switches.name: kGpuLauncher
switches.comment: Extra command line options for launching the GPU process (normally used for debugging). Use like renderer-cmd-prefix.

switches.name: kGpuProcess
switches.comment: Makes this process a GPU sub-process.

switches.name: kGpuSandboxStartEarly
switches.comment: Starts the GPU sandbox before creating a GL context.

switches.name: kGpuStartupDialog
switches.comment: Causes the GPU process to display a dialog on launch.

switches.name: kHideScrollbars
switches.comment: Prevents creating scrollbars for web content. Useful for taking consistent screenshots.

switches.name: kIPCConnectionTimeout
switches.comment: Overrides the timeout, in seconds, that a child process waits for a connection from the browser before killing itself.

switches.name: kInProcessGPU
switches.comment: Run the GPU process as a thread in the browser process.

switches.name: kIpcDumpDirectory
switches.comment: Dumps IPC messages sent from renderer processes to the browser process to the given directory. Used primarily to gather samples for IPC fuzzing.

switches.name: kIpcFuzzerTestcase
switches.comment: Specifies the testcase used by the IPC fuzzer.

switches.name: kIsolateOrigins
switches.comment: Require dedicated processes for a set of origins, specified as a comma-separated list. For example: --isolate-origins=https://www.foo.com,https://www.bar.com

switches.name: kJavaScriptHarmony
switches.comment: Enables experimental Harmony (ECMAScript 6) features.

switches.name: kLaunchAsBrowser
switches.comment: Flag to launch tests in the browser process.

switches.name: kLoadWebUIfromDisk
switches.comment: Flag used to load WebUI files directly from disk instead of pak files. Meant to be used during local development only (requires a local checkout and build), and only works if used along with the GN load_webui_from_disk=true GN flag.

switches.name: kLogFile
switches.comment: Overrides the default file name to use for general-purpose logging (does not affect which events are logged).

switches.name: kLogGpuControlListDecisions
switches.comment: Logs GPU control list decisions when enforcing blocklist rules.

switches.name: kLogMissingUnloadACK
switches.comment: Log an error whenever the unload timeout for a render frame is exceeded.

switches.name: kLoggingLevel
switches.comment: Sets the minimum log level. Valid values are from 0 to 3: INFO = 0, WARNING = 1, LOG_ERROR = 2, LOG_FATAL = 3.

switches.name: kMaxActiveWebGLContexts
switches.comment: Allows user to override maximum number of active WebGL contexts per renderer process.

switches.name: kMaxDecodedImageSizeMb
switches.comment: Sets the maximium decoded image size limitation.

switches.name: kMaxWebMediaPlayerCount
switches.comment: Sets the maximum number of WebMediaPlayers allowed per frame.

switches.name: kMessageLoopTypeUi
switches.comment: Indicates the utility process should run with a message loop type of UI.

switches.name: kMockCertVerifierDefaultResultForTesting
switches.comment: Set the default result for MockCertVerifier. This only works in test code.

switches.name: kMojoLocalStorage
switches.comment: Use a Mojo-based LocalStorage implementation.

switches.name: kNoUnsandboxedZygote
switches.comment: Disables the unsandboxed zygote. Note: this flag should not be used on most platforms. It is introduced because some platforms (e.g. Cast) have very limited memory and binaries won't be updated when the browser process is running.

switches.name: kNoZygote
switches.comment: Disables the use of a zygote process for forking child processes. Instead, child processes will be forked and exec'd directly. Note that --no-sandbox should also be used together with this flag because the sandbox needs the zygote to work.

switches.name: kOverrideLanguageDetection
switches.comment: Overrides the language detection result determined based on the page contents.

switches.name: kPdfRenderer
switches.comment: Renderer process that runs the non-PPAPI PDF plugin.

switches.name: kPrivateAggregationDeveloperMode
switches.comment: Causes the Private Aggregation API to run without reporting delays.

switches.name: kProcessPerSite
switches.comment: Enable the "Process Per Site" process model for all domains. This mode consolidates same-site pages so that they share a single process. More details here: - https://www.chromium.org/developers/design-documents/process-models - The class comment in site_instance.h, listing the supported process models. IMPORTANT: This isn't to be confused with --site-per-process (which is about isolation, not consolidation). You probably want the other one.

switches.name: kProcessPerTab
switches.comment: Runs each set of script-connected tabs (i.e., a BrowsingInstance) in its own renderer process.  We default to using a renderer process for each site instance (i.e., group of pages from the same registered domain with script connections to each other). TODO(creis): This flag is currently a no-op.  We should refactor it to avoid "unnecessary" process swaps for cross-site navigations but still swap when needed for security (e.g., isolated origins).

switches.name: kProcessType
switches.comment: The value of this switch determines whether the process is started as a renderer or plugin host.  If it's empty, it's the browser.

switches.name: kProtectedAudiencesConsentedDebugToken
switches.comment: Causes Protected Audiences Bidding and Auction API to supply the provided debugging key to the trusted auction server. This tells the server that it okay to log information about this user's auction to help with debugging.

switches.name: kPullToRefresh
switches.comment: Enables or disables pull-to-refresh gesture in response to vertical overscroll. Set the value to '0' to disable the feature, set to '1' to enable it for both touchpad and touchscreen, and set to '2' to enable it only for touchscreen. Defaults to disabled.

switches.name: kRaiseTimerFrequency
switches.comment: Raise the timer interrupt frequency in all Chrome processes, for experimental purposes. This feature is needed because as of Windows 10 2004 the scheduling effects of changing the timer interrupt frequency are not global, and this lets us prove/disprove whether this matters. See https://crbug.com/1128917

switches.name: kReduceAcceptLanguage
switches.comment: Reduce the accept-language for HTTP header and JS navigator.languages, and only most preferred language: https://github.com/Tanych/accept-language.

switches.name: kReduceAcceptLanguageHTTP
switches.comment: Reduce the accept-language for HTTP header, and only send most preferred language in the request header: https://github.com/Tanych/accept-language.

switches.name: kReduceUserAgentMinorVersion
switches.comment: Reduce the minor version number in the User-Agent string. This flag implements phase 4 of User-Agent reduction: https://blog.chromium.org/2021/09/user-agent-reduction-origin-trial-and-dates.html.

switches.name: kRemoteAllowOrigins
switches.comment: Enables web socket connections from the specified origins only. '*' allows any origin.

switches.name: kRemoteDebuggingIoPipes
switches.comment: Specifies pipe names for the incoming and outbound messages on the Windows platform. This is a comma separated list of two pipe handles serialized as unsigned integers, e.g. "--remote-debugging-io-pipes=3,4".

switches.name: kRemoteDebuggingPipe
switches.comment: Enables remote debug over stdio pipes [in=3, out=4] or over the remote pipes specified in the 'remote-debugging-io-pipes' switch. Optionally, specifies the format for the protocol messages, can be either "JSON" (the default) or "CBOR".

switches.name: kRemoteDebuggingPort
switches.comment: Enables remote debug over HTTP on the specified port.

switches.name: kRendererCmdPrefix
switches.comment: The contents of this flag are prepended to the renderer command line. Useful values might be "valgrind" or "xterm -e gdb --args".

switches.name: kRendererProcess
switches.comment: Causes the process to run as renderer instead of as browser.

switches.name: kRendererProcessLaunchTimeTicks
switches.comment: Time the browser launched the renderer process (in TimeTicks).

switches.name: kRendererProcessLimit
switches.comment: Overrides the default/calculated limit to the number of renderer processes. Very high values for this setting can lead to high memory/resource usage or instability.

switches.name: kRendererStartupDialog
switches.comment: Causes the renderer process to display a dialog on launch. Passing this flag also adds sandbox::policy::kNoSandbox on Windows non-official builds, since that's needed to show a dialog.

switches.name: kRunManualTestsFlag
switches.comment: Manual tests only run when --run-manual is specified. This allows writing tests that don't run automatically but are still in the same test binary. This is useful so that a team that wants to run a few tests doesn't have to add a new binary that must be compiled on all builds.

switches.name: kSandboxIPCProcess
switches.comment: Causes the process to run as a sandbox IPC subprocess.

switches.name: kSharedFiles
switches.comment: Describes the file descriptors passed to a child process in the following list format: <file_id>:<descriptor_id>,<file_id>:<descriptor_id>,... where <file_id> is an ID string from the manifest of the service being launched and <descriptor_id> is the numeric identifier of the descriptor for the child process can use to retrieve the file descriptor from the global descriptor table.

switches.name: kSingleProcess
switches.comment: Runs the renderer and plugins in the same process as the browser

switches.name: kSitePerProcess
switches.comment: Enforces a one-site-per-process security policy: * Each renderer process, for its whole lifetime, is dedicated to rendering pages for just one site. * Thus, pages from different sites are never in the same process. * A renderer process's access rights are restricted based on its site. * All cross-site navigations force process swaps. * <iframe>s are rendered out-of-process whenever the src= is cross-site. More details here: - https://www.chromium.org/developers/design-documents/site-isolation - https://www.chromium.org/developers/design-documents/process-models - The class comment in site_instance.h, listing the supported process models. IMPORTANT: this isn't to be confused with --process-per-site (which is about process consolidation, not isolation). You probably want this one.

switches.name: kSkiaFontCacheLimitMb
switches.comment: Specifies the max number of bytes that should be used by the skia font cache. If the cache needs to allocate more, skia will purge previous entries.

switches.name: kSkiaResourceCacheLimitMb
switches.comment: Specifies the max number of bytes that should be used by the skia resource cache. The previous entries are purged from the cache when the memory useage exceeds this limit.

switches.name: kStartFullscreen
switches.comment: Specifies if the browser should start in fullscreen mode, like if the user had pressed F11 right after startup.

switches.name: kStatsCollectionController
switches.comment: Specifies if the |StatsCollectionController| needs to be bound in the renderer. This binding happens on per-frame basis and hence can potentially be a performance bottleneck. One should only enable it when running a test that needs to access the provided statistics.

switches.name: kTargetDeviceScaleForTesting
switches.comment: Allows web tests to specify the target device scale for the test cases.

switches.name: kTestType
switches.comment: Type of the current test harness ("browser" or "ui" or "gpu").

switches.name: kTimeTicksAtUnixEpoch
switches.comment: Accepts a number representing the time-ticks value at the Unix epoch. Since different processes can produce a different value for this due to system clock changes, this allows synchronizing them to a single value.

switches.name: kTouchEventFeatureDetection
switches.comment: Enable support for touch event feature detection.

switches.name: kTouchEventFeatureDetectionAuto
switches.comment: The values the kTouchEventFeatureDetection switch may have, as in --touch-events=disabled. auto: enabled at startup when an attached touchscreen is present.

switches.name: kTouchEventFeatureDetectionDisabled
switches.comment: disabled: touch events are disabled.

switches.name: kTouchEventFeatureDetectionEnabled
switches.comment: enabled: touch events always enabled.

switches.name: kUseFakeCodecForPeerConnection
switches.comment: Replaces the existing codecs supported in peer connection with a single fake codec entry that create a fake video encoder and decoder.

switches.name: kUseFakeUIForDigitalIdentity
switches.comment: Bypass the digital-identity-credential OS call. Simulate the user accepting the OS-presented dialog.

switches.name: kUseFakeUIForFedCM
switches.comment: Bypass the FedCM account selection dialog. If a value is provided for this switch, that account ID is selected, otherwise the first account is chosen.

switches.name: kUseFakeUIForMediaStream
switches.comment: Bypass the media stream infobar by selecting the default device for media streams (e.g. WebRTC). Works with --use-fake-device-for-media-stream. Prefer --auto-accept-camera-and-microphone-capture which does not interact with screen/tab capture.

switches.name: kUseMockCertVerifierForTesting
switches.comment: Use the MockCertVerifier. This only works in test code.

switches.name: kUtilityCmdPrefix
switches.comment: The contents of this flag are prepended to the utility process command line. Useful values might be "valgrind" or "xterm -e gdb --args".

switches.name: kUtilityImmediateCrashForTesting
switches.comment: Crash the Utility process early in start-up, for testing.

switches.name: kUtilityProcess
switches.comment: Causes the process to run as a utility subprocess.

switches.name: kUtilityStartupDialog
switches.comment: Causes the utility process to display a dialog on launch.

switches.name: kUtilitySubType
switches.comment: This switch indicates the type of a utility process. It does not affect the services offered by the process, but is added to the command line to make it easier to identify the purpose of the utility process.

switches.name: kV8CacheOptions
switches.comment: Set options to cache V8 data. (none, code, or default)

switches.name: kVerifyPixels
switches.comment: Causes tests to attempt to verify pixel output.

switches.name: kVideoImageTextureTarget
switches.comment: Texture target for CHROMIUM_image backed video frame textures.

switches.name: kWaitForDebuggerChildren
switches.comment: Will add kWaitForDebugger to every child processes. If a value is passed, it will be used as a filter to determine if the child process should have the kWaitForDebugger flag passed on or not.

switches.name: kWaitForDebuggerOnNavigation
switches.comment: On every navigation a message with the renderer's URL will be logged and the renderer will wait for a debugger to be attached or SIGUSR1 to be sent to continue execution.

switches.name: kWaitForDebuggerWebUI
switches.comment: Flag used by WebUI test runners to wait for debugger to be attached.

switches.name: kWebAuthRemoteDesktopSupport
switches.comment: Allows trusted remote desktop clients to make WebAuthn requests on behalf of other origins. This switch only controls availability of the `remoteDesktopClientOverride` extension but doesn't by itself enable any origin to use it.

switches.name: kWebOtpBackend
switches.comment: Enables specified backend for the Web OTP API.

switches.name: kWebOtpBackendAuto
switches.comment: Enables auto backend selection for Web OTP API.

switches.name: kWebOtpBackendSmsVerification
switches.comment: Enables Sms Verification backend for Web OTP API which requires app hash in SMS body.

switches.name: kWebOtpBackendUserConsent
switches.comment: Enables User Consent backend for Web OTP API.

switches.name: kWebRtcLocalEventLogging
switches.comment: Enable capture and local storage of WebRTC event logs without visiting chrome://webrtc-internals. This is useful for automated testing. It accepts the path to which the local logs would be stored. Disabling is not possible without restarting the browser and relaunching without this flag.

switches.name: kWebRtcMaxCaptureFramerate
switches.comment: Override the maximum framerate as can be specified in calls to getUserMedia. This flag expects a value.  Example: --max-gum-fps=17.5

switches.name: kWebSettingsForTesting
switches.comment: Allows web tests to specify additional web settings for the test cases.

switches.name: kWebXrForceRuntime
switches.comment: Forcibly enable and select the specified runtime for webxr. Note that this provides an alternative means of enabling a runtime, and will also functionally disable all other runtimes.

switches.name: kWebXrRuntimeArCore
switches.comment: The following are the runtimes that WebXr supports.

switches.name: kWebXrRuntimeNone
switches.comment: Tell WebXr to assume that it does not support any runtimes.

switches.name: kWebglAntialiasingMode
switches.comment: Set the antialiasing method used for webgl. (none, explicit, implicit)

switches.name: kWebglMSAASampleCount
switches.comment: Set a default sample count for webgl if msaa is enabled.

switches.name: kZygoteCmdPrefix
switches.comment: The prefix used when starting the zygote process. (i.e. 'gdb --args')

switches.name: kZygoteProcess
switches.comment: Causes the process to run as a zygote.

switches.name: kContentShellHideToolbar
switches.comment: Hides toolbar from content_shell's host window.

switches.name: kContentShellHostWindowSize
switches.comment: Size for the content_shell's host window (i.e. "800x600").

switches.name: kCrashDumpsDir
switches.comment: The directory Crashpad should store minidumps in. iOS and tvOS default to app's cache directory.

switches.name: kDisableSystemFontCheck
switches.comment: Disables the check for the system font when specified.

switches.name: kExposeInternalsForTesting
switches.comment: Exposes the window.internals object to JavaScript for interactive development and debugging of web tests that rely on it.

switches.name: kIsolatedContextOrigins
switches.comment: Enables APIs guarded with the [IsolatedContext] IDL attribute for the given comma-separated list of origins.

switches.name: kRemoteDebuggingAddress
switches.comment: Use the given address instead of the default loopback for accepting remote debugging connections. Note that the remote debugging protocol does not perform any authentication, so exposing it too widely can be a security risk.

switches.name: kRunWebTests
switches.comment: Runs Content Shell in web test mode, injecting test-only behaviour for blink web tests.

switches.name: kTestRegisterStandardScheme
switches.comment: Register the provided scheme as a standard scheme.

switches.name: kAllowExternalPages
switches.comment: Allow access to external pages during web tests.

switches.name: kAlwaysUseComplexText
switches.comment: Always use the complex text path for web tests.

switches.name: kCrashOnFailure
switches.comment: When specified to "enable-leak-detection" command-line option, causes the leak detector to cause immediate crash when found leak.

switches.name: kDebugDevTools
switches.comment: Run devtools tests in debug mode (not bundled and minified)

switches.name: kDisableAutoWPTOriginIsolation
switches.comment: Disables the automatic origin isolation of web platform test domains. We normally origin-isolate them for better test coverage, but tests of opt-in origin isolation need to disable this.

switches.name: kDisableHeadlessMode
switches.comment: Disables the shell from beginning in headless mode. Tests will then attempt to use the hardware GPU for rendering. This is only followed when kRunWebTests is set.

switches.name: kEnableAccelerated2DCanvas
switches.comment: Enable accelerated 2D canvas.

switches.name: kEnableFontAntialiasing
switches.comment: Enable font antialiasing for pixel tests.

switches.name: kEnableLeakDetection
switches.comment: Enables the leak detection of loading webpages. This allows us to check whether or not reloading a webpage releases web-related objects correctly.

switches.name: kEncodeBinary
switches.comment: Encode binary web test results (images, audio) using base64.

switches.name: kInspectorProtocolLog
switches.comment: Specifies the path to a file containing a Chrome DevTools protocol log. Each line in the log file is expected to be a protocol message in the JSON format. The test runner will use this log file to script the backend for any inspector-protocol tests that run. Usually you would want to run a single test using the log to reproduce timeouts or crashes.

switches.name: kResetBrowsingInstanceBetweenTests
switches.comment: Forces each web test to be run in a new BrowsingInstance. Required for origin isolation web tests where the BrowsingInstance retains state from origin isolation requests, but this flag may benefit other web tests.

switches.name: kStableReleaseMode
switches.comment: This makes us disable some web-platform runtime features so that we test content_shell as if it was a stable release. It is only followed when kRunWebTest is set. For the features' level, see third_party/blink/renderer/platform/RuntimeEnabledFeatures.md

switches.name: kGamepadPollingInterval
switches.comment: Overrides the gamepad polling interval. Decreasing the interval improves input latency of buttons and axes but may negatively affect performance due to more CPU time spent in the input polling thread.

switches.name: kDisableExtensions
switches.comment: Disables extensions.

switches.name: kDisableExtensionsExcept
switches.comment: Disable extensions except those specified in a comma-separated list.

switches.name: kGCMCheckinURL
switches.comment: Sets the checkin service endpoint that will be used for performing Google Cloud Messaging checkins.

switches.name: kGCMMCSEndpoint
switches.comment: Sets the Mobile Connection Server endpoint that will be used for Google Cloud Messaging.

switches.name: kGCMRegistrationURL
switches.comment: Sets the registration endpoint that will be used for creating new Google Cloud Messaging registrations.

switches.name: kEnableGPUClientLogging
switches.comment: Enable GPU client logging.

switches.name: kEnableGpuClientTracing
switches.comment: Enables TRACE for GL calls in the renderer.

switches.name: kCompileShaderAlwaysSucceeds
switches.comment: Always return success when compiling a shader. Linking will still fail.

switches.name: kDisableGLErrorLimit
switches.comment: Disable the GL error log limit.

switches.name: kDisableGLSLTranslator
switches.comment: Disable the GLSL translator.

switches.name: kDisableGpuProgramCache
switches.comment: Turn off gpu program caching

switches.name: kDisableShaderNameHashing
switches.comment: Turn off user-defined name hashing in shaders.

switches.name: kDisableVulkanSurface
switches.comment: Disables VK_KHR_surface extension. Instead of using swapchain, bitblt will be used for present render result on screen.

switches.name: kEnableGPUCommandLogging
switches.comment: Turn on Logging GPU commands.

switches.name: kEnableGPUDebugging
switches.comment: Turn on Calling GL Error after every command.

switches.name: kEnableGPUDriverDebugLogging
switches.comment: Enable logging of GPU driver debug messages.

switches.name: kEnableGPUServiceLoggingGPU
switches.comment: Enable GPU service logging. Note: This is the same switch as the one in gl_switches.cc. It's defined here again to avoid dependencies between dlls.

switches.name: kEnableThreadedTextureMailboxes
switches.comment: Simulates shared textures when share groups are not available. Not available everywhere.

switches.name: kEnforceGLMinimums
switches.comment: Enforce GL minimums.

switches.name: kForceGpuMemDiscardableLimitMb
switches.comment: Sets the maximum GPU memory to use for discardable caches.

switches.name: kForceMaxTextureSize
switches.comment: Sets the maximum texture size in pixels.

switches.name: kGLShaderIntermOutput
switches.comment: Include ANGLE's intermediate representation (AST) output in shader compilation info logs.

switches.name: kGpuProgramCacheSizeKb
switches.comment: Sets the maximum size of the in-memory gpu program cache, in kb

switches.name: kUseVulkan
switches.comment: Enable Vulkan support and select Vulkan implementation, must also have ENABLE_VULKAN defined. This only initializes Vulkan, the flag --enable-features=Vulkan must also be used to select Vulkan for compositing and rasterization.

switches.name: kCollectDawnInfoEagerly
switches.comment: Start the GPU process for Dawn info collection immediately after the browser starts. The default is to delay for 120 seconds.

switches.name: kDisableDawnFeatures
switches.comment: Set the Dawn features(toggles) disabled on the creation of Dawn devices.

switches.name: kDisableGpuProcessForDX12InfoCollection
switches.comment: Disables the non-sandboxed GPU process for DX12 info collection

switches.name: kDisableGpuRasterization
switches.comment: Disable GPU rasterization, i.e. rasterize on the CPU only. Overrides the kEnableGpuRasterization flag.

switches.name: kDisableGpuShaderDiskCache
switches.comment: Disables the GPU shader on disk cache.

switches.name: kDisableMipmapGeneration
switches.comment: Disables mipmap generation in Skia. Used a workaround for select low memory devices, see https://crbug.com/1138979 for details.

switches.name: kDisableSkiaGraphite
switches.comment: Force disabling/enabling Skia Graphite. Disabling will take precedence over enabling if both are specified.

switches.name: kDisableSkiaGraphitePrecompilation
switches.comment: Force disabling/enabling Skia Graphite's Pipeline Precompilation. Disabling will take precedence over enabling if both are specified.

switches.name: kDisableVulkanFallbackToGLForTesting
switches.comment: Disables falling back to GL based hardware rendering if initializing Vulkan fails. This is to allow tests to catch regressions in Vulkan.

switches.name: kEnableDawnBackendValidation
switches.comment: Enable validation layers in Dawn backends.

switches.name: kEnableDawnFeatures
switches.comment: Set the Dawn features(toggles) enabled on the creation of Dawn devices.

switches.name: kEnableGpuBlockedTime
switches.comment: Enables measures of how long GPU Main Thread was blocked between SwapBuffers

switches.name: kEnableGpuMainTimeKeeperMetrics
switches.comment: Enables ThreadControllerWithMessagePumpImpl's TimeKeeper UMA metrics using CrGpuMain as suffix.

switches.name: kEnableGpuRasterization
switches.comment: Allow heuristics to determine when a layer tile should be drawn with the Skia GPU backend. Only valid with GPU accelerated compositing.

switches.name: kEnableVulkanProtectedMemory
switches.comment: Enables using protected memory for vulkan resources.

switches.name: kEnableWebGPUDeveloperFeatures
switches.comment: Enables WebGPU developer features which are not generally exposed to the web platform.

switches.name: kForceBrowserCrashOnGpuCrash
switches.comment: Crash Chrome if GPU process crashes. This is to force a test to fail when GPU process crashes unexpectedly.

switches.name: kForceSeparateEGLDisplayForWebGLTesting
switches.comment: Force the use of a separate EGL display for WebGL contexts. Used for testing multi-GPU pathways on devices with only one valid GPU.

switches.name: kForceWebGPUCompat
switches.comment: Force all WebGPU content to run in WebGPU Compatibility mode.

switches.name: kGpuBlocklistTestGroup
switches.comment: Select a different set of GPU blocklist entries with the specified test_group ID.

switches.name: kGpuDeviceId
switches.comment: Passes the active graphics device id from browser process to info collection GPU process.

switches.name: kGpuDiskCacheSizeKB
switches.comment: Allows explicitly specifying the shader disk cache size for embedded devices. Default value is 6MB. On Android, 2MB is default and 128KB for low-end devices.

switches.name: kGpuDriverBugListTestGroup
switches.comment: Enable an extra set of GPU driver bug list entries with the specified test_group ID. Note the default test group (group 0) is still active.

switches.name: kGpuDriverVersion
switches.comment: Passes the active graphics driver version from browser process to info collection GPU process.

switches.name: kGpuPreferences
switches.comment: Passes encoded GpuPreferences to GPU process.

switches.name: kGpuRevision
switches.comment: Passes the active graphics revision info from browser process to info collection GPU process.

switches.name: kGpuSubSystemId
switches.comment: Passes the active graphics sub system id from browser process to info collection GPU process.

switches.name: kGpuVendorId
switches.comment: Passes the active graphics vendor id from browser process to info collection GPU process.

switches.name: kGpuWatchdogTimeoutSeconds
switches.comment: Override value for the GPU watchdog timeout in seconds.

switches.name: kIgnoreGpuBlocklist
switches.comment: Ignores GPU blocklist.

switches.name: kNoDelayForDX12VulkanInfoCollection
switches.comment: Start the non-sandboxed GPU process for DX12 and Vulkan info collection immediately after the browser starts. The default is to delay for 120 seconds.

switches.name: kSkiaGraphiteBackend
switches.comment: Specify which backend to use for Skia Graphite - "dawn" (default) or "metal" (only allowed on non-official developer builds).

switches.name: kSuppressPerformanceLogs
switches.comment: Suppresses GL_DEBUG_TYPE_PERFORMANCE log messages for web tests that can get sent to the JS console and cause unnecessary test failures due test output log expectation comparisons.

switches.name: kUseRedistributableDirectML
switches.comment: Try to use a redistributable DirectML.dll. Used for testing WebNN against newer DirectML release before it is integrated into Windows OS. Please see more info about DirectML releases at: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/ai/directml/dml-version-history

switches.name: kUseWebGPUAdapter
switches.comment: The adapter to use for WebGPU content.

switches.name: kUseWebGPUPowerPreference
switches.comment: The adapter selecting strategy related to GPUPowerPreference.

switches.name: kVulkanHeapMemoryLimitMb
switches.comment: Specifies the heap limit for Vulkan memory. TODO(crbug.com/40161102): Remove this switch.

switches.name: kVulkanSyncCpuMemoryLimitMb
switches.comment: Specifies the sync CPU limit for total Vulkan memory. TODO(crbug.com/40161102): Remove this switch.

switches.name: kWebViewDrawFunctorUsesVulkan
switches.comment: Indicate that the this is being used by Android WebView and its draw functor is using vulkan.

switches.name: kAllowVideoCodecs
switches.comment: A comma-separated, case-insenitive list of video codecs to allow. If specified, codecs not matching the list will not be used. '*' will match everything, '-' at the start of an entry means codec is disallowed. First entry that matches determines the outcome. Codec names are as returned by `GetCodecName()` in media/base/video_codecs.cc

switches.name: kBlockNewWebContents
switches.comment: If true, then all pop-ups and calls to window.open will fail.

switches.name: kDeterministicMode
switches.comment: A meta flag. This sets a number of flags which put the browser into deterministic mode where begin frames should be issued over DevToolsProtocol (experimental).

switches.name: kDisableCookieEncryption
switches.comment: Whether cookies stored as part of user profile are encrypted.

switches.name: kDisableCrashReporter
switches.comment: Disable crash reporter for headless. It is enabled by default in official builds.

switches.name: kEnableBackForwardCache
switches.comment: Enable Back Forward Cache support

switches.name: kEnableBeginFrameControl
switches.comment: Whether or not begin frames should be issued over DevToolsProtocol (experimental).

switches.name: kFontRenderHinting
switches.comment: Sets font render hinting when running headless, affects Skia rendering and whether glyph subpixel positioning is enabled. Possible values: none|slight|medium|full|max. Default: full.

switches.name: kForceNewBrowsingInstance
switches.comment: Forces each navigation to use a new BrowsingInstance.

switches.name: kForceReportingDestinationAttested
switches.comment: Force reporting destination attested for headless shell.

switches.name: kNoSystemProxyConfigService
switches.comment: Do not use system proxy configuration service.

switches.name: kScreenInfo
switches.comment: Headless screen info in the format: {0,0 800x600}{800,0 600x800}. See //components/headless/screen_info/README.md for more details.

switches.name: kAlsaInputDevice
switches.comment: The Alsa device to use when opening an audio input stream.

switches.name: kAlsaOutputDevice
switches.comment: The Alsa device to use when opening an audio stream.

switches.name: kAudioBufferSize
switches.comment: Allow users to specify a custom buffer size for debugging purpose.

switches.name: kAudioCodecsFromEDID
switches.comment: Audio codecs supported by the HDMI sink is retrieved from the audio service process. EDID contains the Short Audio Descriptors, which list the audio decoders supported, and the information is presented as a bitmask of supported audio codecs.

switches.name: kAutoGrantCapturedSurfaceControlPrompt
switches.comment: Skip the permission prompt for Captured Surface Control.

switches.name: kAutoplayPolicy
switches.comment: Command line flag name to set the autoplay policy.

switches.name: kCastStreamingForceDisableHardwareH264
switches.comment: NOTE: callers should always use the free functions in /media/cast/encoding/encoding_support.h instead of accessing these features directly. TODO(crbug.com/286443864): Guard Cast Sender flags with !IS_ANDROID. If enabled, completely disables use of H264 hardware encoding for Cast Streaming sessions. Takes precedence over kCastStreamingForceEnableHardwareH264.

switches.name: kCastStreamingForceDisableHardwareVp8
switches.comment: If enabled, completely disables use of VP8 hardware encoding for Cast Streaming sessions. Takes precedence over kCastStreamingForceEnableHardwareVp8.

switches.name: kCastStreamingForceDisableHardwareVp9
switches.comment: If enabled, completely disables use of VP9 hardware encoding for Cast Streaming sessions. Takes precedence over kCastStreamingForceEnableHardwareVp9.

switches.name: kCastStreamingForceEnableHardwareH264
switches.comment: If enabled, allows use of H264 hardware encoding for Cast Streaming sessions, even on platforms where it is disabled due to performance and reliability issues. kCastStreamingForceDisableHardwareH264 must be disabled for this flag to take effect.

switches.name: kCastStreamingForceEnableHardwareVp8
switches.comment: If enabled, allows use of VP8 hardware encoding for Cast Streaming sessions, even on platforms where it is disabled due to performance and reliability issues. kCastStreamingForceDisableHardwareVp8 must be disabled for this flag to take effect.

switches.name: kCastStreamingForceEnableHardwareVp9
switches.comment: If enabled, allows use of VP9 hardware encoding for Cast Streaming sessions, even on platforms where it is disabled due to performance and reliability issues. kCastStreamingForceDisableHardwareVp9 must be disabled for this flag to take effect.

switches.name: kClearKeyCdmPathForTesting
switches.comment: Specifies the path to the Clear Key CDM for testing, which is necessary to support External Clear Key key system when library CDM is enabled. Note that External Clear Key key system support is also controlled by feature kExternalClearKeyForTesting.

switches.name: kDisableAcceleratedMjpegDecode
switches.comment: Disable hardware acceleration of mjpeg decode for captured frame, where available.

switches.name: kDisableAudioInput
switches.comment: Forces input and output stream creation to use fake audio streams.

switches.name: kDisableBackgroundMediaSuspend
switches.comment: Do not immediately suspend media in background tabs.

switches.name: kDisableRTCSmoothnessAlgorithm
switches.comment: Disables the new rendering algorithm for webrtc, which is designed to improve the rendering smoothness.

switches.name: kDocumentUserActivationRequiredPolicy
switches.comment: Autoplay policy that requires a document user activation.

switches.name: kEnableExclusiveAudio
switches.comment: Use exclusive mode audio streaming for Windows Vista and higher. Leads to lower latencies for audio streams which uses the AudioParameters::AUDIO_PCM_LOW_LATENCY audio path. See http://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/dd370844.aspx for details.

switches.name: kEnableLiveCaptionPrefForTesting
switches.comment: Sets the default value for the kLiveCaptionEnabled preference to true.

switches.name: kEnablePrimaryNodeAccessForVkmsTesting
switches.comment: This is needed for V4L2 testing using VISL (virtual driver) on cros VM with arm64-generic-vm. Minigbm buffer allocation is done using dumb driver with vkms.

switches.name: kFailAudioStreamCreation
switches.comment: Causes the AudioManager to fail creating audio streams. Used when testing various failure cases.

switches.name: kFakeBackgroundBlurTogglePeriod
switches.comment: Inserts fake background blur state into `VideoFrameMetadata`. The value represents the period in milliseconds. eg. Setting it to 1000ms, will cause the blur state to cycle between reporting ENABLED for 500ms and DISABLED for 500ms.

switches.name: kForceVideoOverlays
switches.comment: Force media player using SurfaceView instead of SurfaceTexture on Android. Note: This is used by the Cast playback pipeline and must be kept.

switches.name: kForceWaveAudio
switches.comment: Use Windows WaveOut/In audio API even if Core Audio is supported.

switches.name: kHardwareVideoDecodeFrameRate
switches.comment: Some (Qualcomm only at the moment) V4L2 video decoders require setting the framerate so that the hardware decoder can scale the clocks efficiently. This provides a mechanism during testing to lock the decoder framerate to a specific value.

switches.name: kMSEAudioBufferSizeLimitMb
switches.comment: Allows explicitly specifying MSE audio/video buffer sizes as megabytes. Default values are 150M for video and 12M for audio.

switches.name: kMuteAudio
switches.comment: Mutes audio sent to the audio device so it is not audible during automated testing.

switches.name: kNoUserGestureRequiredPolicy
switches.comment: Autoplay policy that does not require any user gesture.

switches.name: kOverrideEnabledCdmInterfaceVersion
switches.comment: Overrides the default enabled library CDM interface version(s) with the one specified with this switch, which will be the only version enabled. For example, on a build where CDM 8, CDM 9 and CDM 10 are all supported (implemented), but only CDM 8 and CDM 9 are enabled by default: --override-enabled-cdm-interface-version=8 : Only CDM 8 is enabled --override-enabled-cdm-interface-version=9 : Only CDM 9 is enabled --override-enabled-cdm-interface-version=10 : Only CDM 10 is enabled --override-enabled-cdm-interface-version=11 : No CDM interface is enabled This can be used for local testing and debugging. It can also be used to enable an experimental CDM interface (which is always disabled by default) for testing while it's still in development.

switches.name: kOverrideHardwareSecureCodecsForTesting
switches.comment: Overrides hardware secure codecs support for testing. If specified, real platform hardware secure codecs check will be skipped. Valid codecs are: - video: "vp8", "vp9", "avc1", "hevc", "dolbyvision", "av01" - video that does not support clear lead: `<video>-no-clearlead`, where <video> is from the list above. - audio: "mp4a", "vorbis" Codecs are separated by comma. For example: --override-hardware-secure-codecs-for-testing=vp8,vp9-no-clearlead,vorbis --override-hardware-secure-codecs-for-testing=avc1,mp4a CENC encryption scheme is assumed to be supported for the specified codecs. If no valid codecs specified, no hardware secure codecs are supported. This can be used to disable hardware secure codecs support: --override-hardware-secure-codecs-for-testing

switches.name: kReportVp9AsAnUnsupportedMimeType
switches.comment: Force to report VP9 as an unsupported MIME type.

switches.name: kSystemAecEnabled
switches.comment: Enforce system audio echo cancellation.

switches.name: kTrySupportedChannelLayouts
switches.comment: Instead of always using the hardware channel layout, check if a driver supports the source channel layout.  Avoids outputting empty channels and permits drivers to enable stereo to multichannel expansion.  Kept behind a flag since some drivers lie about supported layouts and hang when used.  See http://crbug.com/259165 for more details.

switches.name: kUnsafelyAllowProtectedMediaIdentifierForDomain
switches.comment: For automated testing of protected content, this switch allows specific domains (e.g. example.com) to always allow the permission to share the protected media identifier. In this context, domain does not include the port number. User's content settings will not be affected by enabling this switch. Reference: https://crbug.com/41317087 Example: --unsafely-allow-protected-media-identifier-for-domain=a.com,b.ca

switches.name: kUseCras
switches.comment: Use CRAS, the ChromeOS audio server.

switches.name: kUseFakeDeviceForMediaStream
switches.comment: Use fake device for Media Stream to replace actual camera and microphone. For the list of allowed parameters, see FakeVideoCaptureDeviceFactory::ParseFakeDevicesConfigFromOptionsString().

switches.name: kUseFakeMjpegDecodeAccelerator
switches.comment: Use a fake device for accelerated decoding of MJPEG. This allows, for example, testing of the communication to the GPU service without requiring actual accelerator hardware to be present.

switches.name: kUseFileForFakeAudioCapture
switches.comment: Play a .wav file as the microphone. Note that for WebRTC calls we'll treat the bits as if they came from the microphone, which means you should disable audio processing (lest your audio file will play back distorted). The input file is converted to suit Chrome's audio buses if necessary, so most sane .wav files should work. You can pass either <path> to play the file looping or <path>%noloop to stop after playing the file to completion. Must also be used with kDisableAudioInput or kUseFakeDeviceForMediaStream.

switches.name: kUseFileForFakeVideoCapture
switches.comment: Use an .y4m file to play as the webcam. See the comments in media/capture/video/file_video_capture_device.h for more details.

switches.name: kUserGestureRequiredPolicy
switches.comment: Autoplay policy to require a user gesture in order to play.

switches.name: kVideoThreads
switches.comment: Set number of threads to use for video decoding.

switches.name: kWaveOutBuffers
switches.comment: Number of buffers to use for WaveOut.

switches.name: kDisableVideoCaptureUseGpuMemoryBuffer
switches.comment: This is for the same feature controlled by kVideoCaptureUseGpuMemoryBuffer. kVideoCaptureUseGpuMemoryBuffer is settled by chromeos overlays. This flag is necessary to overwrite the settings via chrome:// flag. The behavior of chrome://flag#zero-copy-video-capture is as follows; Default  : Respect chromeos overlays settings. Enabled  : Force to enable kVideoCaptureUseGpuMemoryBuffer. Disabled : Force to disable kVideoCaptureUseGpuMemoryBuffer.

switches.name: kVideoCaptureUseGpuMemoryBuffer
switches.comment: Enables GpuMemoryBuffer-based buffer pool.

switches.name: kMojoIsBroker
switches.comment: Forces the process's global Mojo node to be configured as a broker. Only honored for test runners using MojoTestSuiteBase.

switches.name: kNoMojo
switches.comment: Disables Mojo initialization completely in the process. Only applies to test child processes. See base::MultiprocessTest.

switches.name: kAttachmentName
switches.comment: For client applications who expect a single Mojo invitation attachment with a free-form name assigned to it, this specifies that attachment name. Either this or kNumericAttachmentNames must be specified on the command line.

switches.name: kHostIpczTransportFd
switches.comment: The integer value of a file descriptor inherited by the mojo_proxy process when launched by its host. This descriptor references a Unix socket which is connected to the host process which launched this proxy to sit between the host and some legacy client application. Required.

switches.name: kInheritIpczBroker
switches.comment: By default, mojo_proxy assumes its host is a broker. When this flag is given it instead assumes its host is a non-broker who is offering to share their broker. The proxy must be configured correctly in this regard or all connections through it will fail.

switches.name: kLegacyClientFd
switches.comment: The integer value of a file descriptor inherited by the mojo_proxy process when launched by its host. This descriptor references a Unix socket which is connected to the legacy client application to be the target of this proxy. Required.

switches.name: kNumAttachments
switches.comment: For client applications who expect Mojo invitation attachments to be assigned zero-based 64-bit integral values, this specifies the number of in-use attachments. The names are implicitly sequental integers starting from 0.

switches.name: kAddXrAppContainerCaps
switches.comment: Add additional capabilities to the AppContainer sandbox used for XR compositing.

switches.name: kAllowSandboxDebugging
switches.comment: Allows debugging of sandboxed processes (see zygote_main_linux.cc).

switches.name: kAllowThirdPartyModules
switches.comment: Allows third party modules to inject by disabling the BINARY_SIGNATURE mitigation policy on Win10+. Also has other effects in ELF.

switches.name: kDisableGpuSandbox
switches.comment: Disables the GPU process sandbox.

switches.name: kDisableLandlockSandbox
switches.comment: Disables the Landlock sandbox (Android only).

switches.name: kDisableMetalShaderCache
switches.comment: Disables Metal's shader cache, using the GPU sandbox to prevent access to it.

switches.name: kDisableNamespaceSandbox
switches.comment: Disables usage of the namespace sandbox.

switches.name: kDisableSeccompFilterSandbox
switches.comment: Disable the seccomp filter sandbox (seccomp-bpf) (Linux only).

switches.name: kDisableSetuidSandbox
switches.comment: Disable the setuid sandbox (Linux only).

switches.name: kEnableSandboxLogging
switches.comment: Cause the OS X sandbox write to syslog every time an access to a resource is denied by the sandbox.

switches.name: kGpuSandboxAllowSysVShm
switches.comment: Allows shmat() system call in the GPU sandbox.

switches.name: kGpuSandboxFailuresFatal
switches.comment: Makes GPU sandbox failures fatal.

switches.name: kNoSandbox
switches.comment: Disables the sandbox for all process types that are normally sandboxed. Meant to be used as a browser-level switch for testing purposes only.

switches.name: kNoZygoteSandbox
switches.comment: Instructs the zygote to launch without a sandbox. Processes forked from this type of zygote will apply their own custom sandboxes later.

switches.name: kServiceSandboxType
switches.comment: Type of sandbox to apply to the process running the service, one of the values in the next block.

switches.name: kDisableHidBlocklist
switches.comment: Disable the HID blocklist.

switches.name: kAdditionalTrustTokenKeyCommitments
switches.comment: Manually sets additional Private State Tokens key commitments in the network service to the given value, which should be a JSON dictionary satisfying the requirements of TrustTokenKeyCommitmentParser::ParseMultipleIssuers. These keys are available in addition to keys provided by the most recent call to TrustTokenKeyCommitments::Set. For issuers with keys provided through both the command line and TrustTokenKeyCommitments::Set, the keys provided through the command line take precedence.
