This is because someone testing manually might want to pass additional keys via the command line to a real Chrome release with the component updater enabled, and it would be surprising if the manually-passed keys were overwritten some time after startup when the component updater runs.

switches.name: kDisableSharedDictionaryStorageCleanupForTesting
switches.comment: The switch to disable the shared dictionary storage clean up task. Only for testing.

switches.name: kForceEffectiveConnectionType
switches.comment: Forces Network Quality Estimator (NQE) to return a specific effective connection type.

switches.name: kForcePermissionPolicyUnloadDefaultEnabled
switches.comment: If set, the unload event cannot be disabled by default by Permissions-Policy.

switches.name: kHostResolverRules
switches.comment: These mappings only apply to the host resolver.

switches.name: kHostRules
switches.comment: Deprecated alias for backwards compatibility, now does the same thing as --host-resolver-rules which should be used instead. TODO(crbug.com/40070729): consider removing in some future release.

switches.name: kIgnoreBadMessageForTesting
switches.comment: The switch to ignore bad mojo message reports. Only for testing.

switches.name: kIgnoreCertificateErrorsSPKIList
switches.comment: A set of public key hashes for which to ignore certificate-related errors. If the certificate chain presented by the server does not validate, and one or more certificates have public key hashes that match a key from this list, the error is ignored. The switch value must be a comma-separated list of Base64-encoded SHA-256 SPKI Fingerprints (RFC 7469, Section 2.4). This switch has no effect unless --user-data-dir (as defined by the content embedder) is also present.

switches.name: kIpAddressSpaceOverrides
switches.comment: Specifies manual overrides to the IP endpoint -> IP address space mapping. This allows running local tests against "public" and "local" IP addresses. This switch is specified as a comma-separated list of overrides. Each override is given as a colon-separated "<endpoint>:<address space>" pair. Grammar, in pseudo-BNF format: switch := override-list override-list := override “,” override-list | <nil> override := ip-endpoint “=” address-space address-space := “public” | “private” | “local” | "loopback" ip-endpoint := ip-address ":" port ip-address := see `net::ParseURLHostnameToAddress()` for details port := integer in the [0-65535] range Any invalid entries in the comma-separated list are ignored. If the port specified is 0, all ports for the given ip-address will be overridden. See also the design doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-umCGylIOuSG02k9KGDwKayt3bzBXtGwVlCQHHkIcnQ/edit# And the Web Platform Test RFC #72 behind it: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/rfcs/blob/master/rfcs/address_space_overrides.md Note that since the doc and the RFC were written, the address space names have changed slightly due to Local Network Access (LNA) replacing Private Network Access (PNA).

switches.name: kLogNetLog
switches.comment: Enables saving net log events to a file. If a value is given, it used as the path the the file, otherwise the file is named netlog.json and placed in the user data directory.

switches.name: kLogNetLogDuration
switches.comment: Specifies the duration (in seconds) for network logging. When this flag is provided with a positive integer value X, Chrome will automatically stop collecting NetLog events after X seconds and flush the log to disk.

switches.name: kNetLogCaptureMode
switches.comment: Sets the granularity of events to capture in the network log. The mode can be set to one of the following values: "Default" "IncludeSensitive" "Everything" See the enums of the corresponding name in net_log_capture_mode.h for a description of their meanings.

switches.name: kNetLogMaxSizeMb
switches.comment: Sets the maximum size, in megabytes. The log file can grow to before older data is overwritten. Do not use this flag if you want an unlimited file size.

switches.name: kSSLKeyLogFile
switches.comment: Causes SSL key material to be logged to the specified file for debugging purposes. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Mozilla/Projects/NSS/Key_Log_Format for the format.

switches.name: kUnsafelyTreatInsecureOriginAsSecure
switches.comment: Treat given (insecure) origins as secure origins. Multiple origins can be supplied as a comma-separated list. For the definition of secure contexts, see https://w3c.github.io/webappsec-secure-contexts/ and https://www.w3.org/TR/powerful-features/#is-origin-trustworthy Example: --unsafely-treat-insecure-origin-as-secure=http://a.test,http://b.test

switches.name: kUseFirstPartySet
switches.comment: Allows the manual specification of a First-Party Set. The format is the same as that of `--use-related-website-set`. DEPRECATED(crbug.com/1486689): This switch is under deprecation due to renaming "First-Party Set" to "Related Website Set". Please use `kUseRelatedWebsiteSet` instead.

switches.name: kUseRelatedWebsiteSet
switches.comment: Allows the manual specification of a Related Website Set. The set should be provided as a stringified JSON object, whose format matches the format of the JSON in https://github.com/GoogleChrome/related-website-sets.

switches.name: kDisableChromeTracingComputation
switches.comment: Disable the tracing service graph compuation while writing the trace.

switches.name: kServiceName
switches.comment: Indicates the name of the service to run. Useful for debugging, or if a service executable is built to support being run as a number of potential different services.

switches.name: kServiceRequestAttachmentName
switches.comment: The name of the |mojo::PendingReceiver<service_manager::mojom::Service>| message pipe handle that is attached to the incoming Mojo invitation received by the service.

switches.name: kEnableTracing
switches.comment: Enable the tracing service.

switches.name: kWebNNCoreMlDumpModel
switches.comment: Copy the generated Core ML model to the folder specified by --webnn-coreml-dump-model, note: folder needs to be accessible from the GPU sandbox or use --no-sandbox. Usage: --no-sandbox --webnn-coreml-dump-model=/tmp/CoreMLModels

switches.name: kWebNNOrtDisableCpuFallback
switches.comment: This switch allows us to disable the fallback to default ORT CPU EP which is enabled by default. When this switch is set: 1. ORT session creation fails if non-CPU EPs cannot fully support all graph nodes. 2. Disables OpenVINO EP internal CPU fallback if NPU model compilation fails (for debugging). Usage: --webnn-ort-disable-cpu-fallback

switches.name: kWebNNOrtDumpModel
switches.comment: Set the folder specified by --webnn-ort-dump-model for ONNX Runtime to save optimized ONNX model after graph level transformations. Usage: --no-sandbox --webnn-ort-dump-model=/tmp/ort_models

switches.name: kWebNNOrtEnableProfiling
switches.comment: This switch allows us to collect ORT profile data for performance analysis. The profile data file is generated in Chrome's folder with a fixed naming format "prefix_date_time.json". The prefix can be provided by user or use "WebNNOrtProfile" as default. Usage: --no-sandbox --webnn-ort-enable-profiling="WebNNOrtOvCpuProfile"

switches.name: kWebNNOrtEpDevice
switches.comment: Force ONNX Runtime to only select one specific execution provider (EP) device which matches the given EP name, hardware vendor id and hardware device id for WebNN during the ORT session creation stage. Notes: 1. Available EP devices can be queried in logs when the `webnn-ort-logging-level` is set to `VERBOSE` or `INFO`. If no matching device is found, the ORT session creation fails. 2. The CPU fallback EP device is added implicitly in ORT by default unless disabled explicitly by `webnn-ort-disable-cpu-fallback` switch. The value should be in the format: <ep_name>,<hardware_vendor_id>,<hardware_device_id> Please note that all the entries must be provided in order, and both hardware_vendor_id and hardware_device_id are hexadecimal strings. Usage: For example, specifying an Intel GPU device using OpenVINO EP: --webnn-ort-ep-device=OpenVINOExecutionProvider,0x8086,0x4680

switches.name: kWebNNOrtEpLibraryPathForTesting
switches.comment: Specify the ORT EP name and library path pair via this switch for testing development EP builds. Libraries of the ORT EP specified by the EP name are forced to be loaded from the specified path. This switch is not to be used in shipping scenarios and is ignored by default. The value should be in the format <ep_name>?<ep_library_path>. Usage: --webnn-ort-ep-library-path-for-testing=OpenVINOExecutionProvider?"C:\Program Files\ONNXRuntime-EP\onnxruntime_providers_openvino_plugin.dll" --allow-third-party-modules

switches.name: kWebNNOrtGraphOptimizationLevel
switches.comment: Configure the graph optimization level of ONNX Runtime. Usage: --webnn-ort-graph-optimization-level=DISABLE_ALL Other levels could be "BASIC", "EXTENDED" and "ALL".

switches.name: kWebNNOrtIgnoreEpBlocklist
switches.comment: Enable all execution providers, ignoring the enabled flag blocklist.

switches.name: kWebNNOrtIgnoreIhvEps
switches.comment: Ignore all IHV execution providers, only the default CPUExecutionProvider and DmlExecutionProvider will be used.

switches.name: kWebNNOrtLibraryPathForTesting
switches.comment: Force onnxruntime.dll to be loaded from a location specified by the switch for testing development ORT build. This switch is not to be used in shipping scenarios and is ignored by default. Usage: --webnn-ort-library-path-for-testing="C:\Program Files\ONNXRuntime" --allow-third-party-modules

switches.name: kWebNNOrtLoggingLevel
switches.comment: Configure the logging severity level of ONNX Runtime. Usage: --webnn-ort-logging-level=VERBOSE Other severity levels could be "INFO", "WARNING", "ERROR" (default), and "FATAL".

switches.name: kWebNNTfliteDumpModel
switches.comment: Save the generated TFLite model file to the folder specified by --webnn-tflite-dump-model. Note, the folder needs to be accessible from the GPU process sandbox or --no-sandbox must be used. Usage: --no-sandbox --webnn-tflite-dump-model=/tmp/tflite_models

switches.name: kAllowPreCommitInput
switches.comment: Allows processing of input before a frame has been committed. TODO(crbug.com/987626): Used by headless. Look for a way not involving a command line switch.

switches.name: kBlinkSettings
switches.comment: Set blink settings. Format is <name>[=<value],<name>[=<value>],... The names are declared in Settings.json5. For boolean type, use "true", "false", or omit '=<value>' part to set to true. For enum type, use the int value of the enum value. Applied after other command line flags and prefs.

switches.name: kCSSCustomStateDeprecatedSyntaxEnabled
switches.comment: Used to communicate managed policy for CSSCustomStateDeprecatedSyntax. This feature is typically controlled by a RuntimeEnabledFeature, but requires an enterprise policy override.

switches.name: kDarkModeSettings
switches.comment: Sets dark mode settings. Format is [<param>=<value>],[<param>=<value>],... The params take either int or float values. If params are not specified, the default dark mode settings is used. Valid params are given below. "InversionAlgorithm" takes int value of DarkModeInversionAlgorithm enum. "ImagePolicy" takes int value of DarkModeImagePolicy enum. "ForegroundBrightnessThreshold" takes 0 to 255 int value. "BackgroundBrightnessThreshold" takes 0 to 255 int value. "ContrastPercent" takes -1.0 to 1.0 float value. Higher the value, more the contrast.

switches.name: kDataUrlInSvgUseEnabled
switches.comment: Overrides data: URLs in SVGUseElement deprecation through enterprise policy.

switches.name: kDefaultTileWidth
switches.comment: Sets the tile size used by composited layers.

switches.name: kDisableBlobUrlPartitioning
switches.comment: Toggles partitioning of Blob URLs through enterprise policy.

switches.name: kDisableImageAnimationResync
switches.comment: Disallow image animations to be reset to the beginning to avoid skipping many frames. Only effective if compositor image animations are enabled.

switches.name: kDisablePartialRaster
switches.comment: Disable partial raster in the renderer. Disabling this switch also disables the use of persistent gpu memory buffers.

switches.name: kDisablePreferCompositingToLCDText
switches.comment: Disable the creation of compositing layers when it would prevent LCD text.

switches.name: kDisableRGBA4444Textures
switches.comment: Disables RGBA_4444 textures.

switches.name: kDisableReduceAcceptLanguage
switches.comment: Override mechanism for ReduceAcceptLanguage. This feature is typically controlled by base features, but requires an enterprise policy override.

switches.name: kDisableStandardizedBrowserZoom
switches.comment: Override mechanism for preserving the old non-standard behavior of CSS zoom.

switches.name: kDisableZeroCopy
switches.comment: Disable rasterizer that writes directly to GPU memory associated with tiles.

switches.name: kDumpRuntimeCallStats
switches.comment: Logs Runtime Call Stats. --single-process also needs to be used along with this for the stats to be logged.

switches.name: kEnableGpuMemoryBufferCompositorResources
switches.comment: Specify that all compositor resources should be backed by GPU memory buffers.

switches.name: kEnableLeakDetectionHeapSnapshot
switches.comment: Enables taking a heap snapshot and dumping it to file when using leak detection.

switches.name: kEnablePreferCompositingToLCDText
switches.comment: Enable the creation of compositing layers when it would prevent LCD text.

switches.name: kEnableRGBA4444Textures
switches.comment: Enables RGBA_4444 textures.

switches.name: kEnableRasterSideDarkModeForImages
switches.comment: Enables raster side dark mode for images.

switches.name: kEnableZeroCopy
switches.comment: Enable rasterizer that writes directly to GPU memory associated with tiles.

switches.name: kForceGpuMemAvailableMb
switches.comment: Sets the total amount of memory that may be allocated for GPU resources in cc.

switches.name: kGpuRasterizationMSAASampleCount
switches.comment: The number of multisample antialiasing samples for GPU rasterization. Requires MSAA support on GPU to have an effect. 0 disables MSAA.

switches.name: kIntensiveWakeUpThrottlingPolicy
switches.comment: Used to communicate managed policy for the IntensiveWakeUpThrottling feature. This feature is typically controlled by base::Feature (see renderer/platform/scheduler/common/features.*) but requires an enterprise policy override. This is implicitly a tri-state, and can be either unset, or set to "1" for force enable, or "0" for force disable.

switches.name: kJavaScriptFlags
switches.comment: Specifies the flags passed to JS engine.

switches.name: kLegacyTechReportPolicyEnabled
switches.comment: A command line to indicate if there ia any legacy tech report urls being set. If so, we will send report from blink to browser process.

switches.name: kMaxUntiledLayerHeight
switches.comment: Sets the width and height above which a composited layer will get tiled.

switches.name: kMinHeightForGpuRasterTile
switches.comment: Sets the min tile height for GPU raster.

switches.name: kNetworkQuietTimeout
switches.comment: Sets the timeout seconds of the network-quiet timers in IdlenessDetector. Used by embedders who want to change the timeout time in order to run web contents on various embedded devices and changeable network bandwidths in different regions. For example, it's useful when using FirstMeaningfulPaint signal to dismiss a splash screen.

switches.name: kShowLayoutShiftRegions
switches.comment: Visibly render a border around layout shift rects in the web page to help debug and study layout shifts.

switches.name: kShowPaintRects
switches.comment: Visibly render a border around paint rects in the web page to help debug and study painting behavior.

switches.name: kTouchTextSelectionStrategy
switches.comment: Controls how text selection granularity changes when touch text selection handles are dragged. Should be "character" or "direction". If not specified, the platform default is used.

switches.name: kWebAudioBypassOutputBufferingOptOut
switches.comment: Used to communicate managed policy for WebAudioBypassOutputBuffering.  This feature is typically controlled by a RuntimeEnabledFeature, but requires an enterprise policy override.

switches.name: kDisableRendererAccessibility
switches.comment: Turns off the accessibility in the renderer.

switches.name: kEnableExperimentalAccessibilityAutoclick
switches.comment: Shows additional automatic click features that haven't launched yet.

switches.name: kEnableExperimentalAccessibilityLabelsDebugging
switches.comment: Enables support for visually debugging the accessibility labels feature, which provides images descriptions for screen reader users.

switches.name: kEnableExperimentalAccessibilityLanguageDetection
switches.comment: Enables language detection on in-page text content which is then exposed to assistive technology such as screen readers.

switches.name: kEnableExperimentalAccessibilityLanguageDetectionDynamic
switches.comment: Enables language detection for dynamic content which is then exposed to assistive technology such as screen readers.

switches.name: kEnableExperimentalAccessibilityManifestV3
switches.comment: Switches accessibility extensions to use extensions manifest v3 while the migration is still in progress.

switches.name: kEnableExperimentalAccessibilitySwitchAccessText
switches.comment: Enables in progress Switch Access features for text input.

switches.name: kEnableMacAccessibilityAPIMigration
switches.comment: Enables the switchover to the newer NSAccessibility property-based API.

switches.name: kEnableMagnifierDebugDrawRect
switches.comment: Enables debug feature for drawing rectangle around magnified region, without zooming in.

switches.name: kForceRendererAccessibility
switches.comment: Force renderer accessibility to be on instead of enabling it on demand when a screen reader is detected. The disable-renderer-accessibility switch overrides this if present. This switch has an optional parameter that forces an AXMode bundle. The three available bundle settings are: 'basic', 'form-controls', and 'complete'. If the bundle argument is invalid, then the forced AXMode will default to 'complete'. If the bundle argument is missing, then the initial AXMode will default to complete but allow changes to the AXMode during execution.

switches.name: kDRMVirtualConnectorIsExternal
switches.comment: Treats DRM virtual connector as external to enable display mode change in VM.

switches.name: kDisableGtkIme
switches.comment: Disables GTK IME integration.

switches.name: kDisableModalAnimations
switches.comment: Disable animations for showing and hiding modal dialogs.

switches.name: kDisallowNonExactResourceReuse
switches.comment: Test related. Disable re-use of non-exact resources to fulfill ResourcePool requests. Intended only for use in layout or pixel tests to reduce noise.

switches.name: kForceCaptionStyle
switches.comment: Forces the caption style for WebVTT captions.

switches.name: kForceDarkMode
switches.comment: Forces dark mode in UI for platforms that support it.

switches.name: kForceHighContrast
switches.comment: Forces high-contrast mode for native UI and web content, regardless of system settings.

switches.name: kGtkVersionFlag
switches.comment: Specify the GTK version to be loaded.

switches.name: kLang
switches.comment: The language file that we want to try to open. Of the form language[-country] where language is the 2 letter code from ISO-639. On Linux, this flag does not work; use the LC_*/LANG environment variables instead.

switches.name: kMangleLocalizedStrings
switches.comment: Transform localized strings to be longer, with beginning and end markers to make truncation visually apparent.

switches.name: kQtVersionFlag
switches.comment: Specify the QT version to be loaded.

switches.name: kShowMacOverlayBorders
switches.comment: Show borders around CALayers corresponding to overlays and partial damage.

switches.name: kShowOverdrawFeedback
switches.comment: Visualize overdraw by color-coding elements based on if they have other elements drawn underneath. This is good for showing where the UI might be doing more rendering work than necessary. The colors are hinting at the amount of overdraw on your screen for each pixel, as follows: True color: No overdraw. Blue: Overdrawn once. Green: Overdrawn twice. Pink: Overdrawn three times. Red: Overdrawn four or more times.

switches.name: kSlowDownCompositingScaleFactor
switches.comment: Re-draw everything multiple times to simulate a much slower machine. Give a slow down factor to cause renderer to take that many times longer to complete, such as --slow-down-compositing-scale-factor=2.

switches.name: kSystemFontFamily
switches.comment: Specifies system font family name. Improves determinism when rendering pages in headless mode.

switches.name: kTintCompositedContent
switches.comment: Tint composited color.

switches.name: kTopChromeTouchUi
switches.comment: Controls touch-optimized UI layout for top chrome.

switches.name: kUIDisablePartialSwap
switches.comment: Disable partial swap which is needed for some OpenGL drivers / emulators.

switches.name: kUiToolkitFlag
switches.comment: Specify the toolkit used to construct the Linux GUI.

switches.name: kUseSystemClipboard
switches.comment: Enables the ozone x11 clipboard for linux-chromeos.

switches.name: kEnablePixelOutputInTests
switches.comment: Forces tests to produce pixel output when they normally wouldn't.

switches.name: kEnableSoftwareMirroring
switches.comment: Enables software based mirroring.

switches.name: kEnsureForcedColorProfile
switches.comment: Crash the browser at startup if the display's color profile does not match the forced color profile. This is necessary on Mac because Chrome's pixel output is always subject to the color conversion performed by the operating system. On all other platforms, this is a no-op.

switches.name: kForceDeviceScaleFactor
switches.comment: Overrides the device scale factor for the browser UI and the contents.

switches.name: kForceDisplayColorProfile
switches.comment: Force all monitors to be treated as though they have the specified color profile. Accepted values are "srgb" and "generic-rgb" (currently used by Mac layout tests) and "color-spin-gamma24" (used by layout tests).

switches.name: kForceRasterColorProfile
switches.comment: Force rastering to take place in the specified color profile. Accepted values are the same as for the kForceDisplayColorProfile case above.

switches.name: kHostWindowBounds
switches.comment: Sets a window size, optional position, optional scale factor and optional panel radii. "1024x768" creates a window of size 1024x768. "100+200-1024x768" positions the window at 100,200. "1024x768*2" sets the scale factor to 2 for a high DPI display. "1024x768~15|15|12|12" sets the radii of the panel corners as (upper_left=15px,upper_right=15px, lower_right=12px, upper_left=12px) "800,0+800-800x800" for two displays at 800x800 resolution. "800,0+800-800x800,0+1600-800x800" for three displays at 800x800 resolution.

switches.name: kScreenConfig
switches.comment: Specifies the initial screen configuration, or state of all displays, for FakeDisplayDelegate, see class for format details.

switches.name: kSecondaryDisplayLayout
switches.comment: Specifies the layout mode and offsets for the secondary display for testing. The format is "<t|r|b|l>,<offset>" where t=TOP, r=RIGHT, b=BOTTOM and L=LEFT. For example, 'r,-100' means the secondary display is positioned on the right with -100 offset. (above than primary)

switches.name: kUseFirstDisplayAsInternal
switches.comment: Uses the 1st display in --ash-host-window-bounds as internal display. This is for debugging on linux desktop.

switches.name: kCompensateForUnstablePinchZoom
switches.comment: Enable compensation for unstable pinch zoom. Some touch screens display significant amount of wobble when moving a finger in a straight line. This makes two finger scroll trigger an oscillating pinch zoom. See crbug.com/394380 for details.

switches.name: kDisableCancelAllTouches
switches.comment: Disable CancelAllTouches() function for the implementation on cancel single touches.

switches.name: kEdgeTouchFiltering
switches.comment: Tells Chrome to do edge touch filtering. Useful for convertible tablet.

switches.name: kEnableMicrophoneMuteSwitchDeviceSwitch
switches.comment: Enables logic to detect microphone mute switch device state, which disables internal audio input when toggled.

switches.name: kPenDevices
switches.comment: Tells chrome to interpret events from these devices as pen events. Only available with XInput 2 (i.e. X server 1.8 or above). The id's of the devices can be retrieved from 'xinput list'.

switches.name: kTouchDevices
switches.comment: Tells chrome to interpret events from these devices as touch events. Only available with XInput 2 (i.e. X server 1.8 or above). The id's of the devices can be retrieved from 'xinput list'.

switches.name: kTouchSlopDistance
switches.comment: Overrides touch slop distance for gesture detection. The touch slop distance is the maximum distance from the starting point of a touch sequence that a gesture can travel before it can no longer be considered a tap. Scroll gestures can only begin after this distance has been travelled. The switch value is a floating point number that is interpreted as a distance in pixels.

switches.name: kAnimationDurationScale
switches.comment: Scale factor to apply to every animation duration. Must be >= 0.0. This will only apply to LinearAnimation and its subclasses.

switches.name: kDisableFontSubpixelPositioning
switches.comment: Force disables font subpixel positioning. This affects the character glyph sharpness, kerning, hinting and layout.

switches.name: kEnableNativeGpuMemoryBuffers
switches.comment: Enable native CPU-mappable GPU memory buffer support on Linux.

switches.name: kForcePrefersNoReducedMotion
switches.comment: Forces whether the user desires no reduced motion, regardless of system settings.

switches.name: kForcePrefersReducedMotion
switches.comment: Forces whether the user desires reduced motion, regardless of system settings.

switches.name: kNoXshm
switches.comment: Disables MIT-SHM extension. In use only with Ozone/X11.

switches.name: kX11Display
switches.comment: Which X11 display to connect to. Emulates the GTK+ "--display=" command line argument. In use only with Ozone/X11.

switches.name: kANGLEImplementationD3D11NULLName
switches.comment: Special switches for "NULL"/stub driver implementations.

switches.name: kCmdDecoderValidatingName
switches.comment: The command decoder names that can be passed to --use-cmd-decoder.

switches.name: kDirectCompositionVideoSwapChainFormat
switches.comment: Used for overriding the swap chain format for direct composition SDR video overlays.

switches.name: kDisableANGLEFeatures
switches.comment: Disables specified comma separated ANGLE features if found.

switches.name: kDisableD3D11Warp
switches.comment: Explicitly disable D3D11 WARP fallback. Some test suites prefer falling back to swiftshader.

switches.name: kDisableDirectComposition
switches.comment: Disable DirectComposition.

switches.name: kDisableGLDrawingForTests
switches.comment: Disables GL drawing operations which produce pixel output. With this the GL output will not be correct but tests will run faster.

switches.name: kDisableGLExtensions
switches.comment: Disables specified comma separated GL Extensions if found.

switches.name: kDisableGpuDriverBugWorkarounds
switches.comment: Disable workarounds for various GPU driver bugs.

switches.name: kDisableGpuVsync
switches.comment: Stop the GPU from synchronizing presentation with vblank.

switches.name: kEnableANGLEFeatures
switches.comment: ANGLE features are defined per-backend in third_party/angle/include/platform Enables specified comma separated ANGLE features if found.

switches.name: kEnableDirectCompositionVideoOverlays
switches.comment: Enable DirectComposition video overlays even if hardware doesn't support it.

switches.name: kEnableGPUServiceTracing
switches.comment: Turns on calling TRACE for every GL call.

switches.name: kEnableSgiVideoSync
switches.comment: Enable use of the SGI_video_sync extension, which can have driver/sandbox/window manager compatibility issues.

switches.name: kEnableSwapBuffersWithBounds
switches.comment: Enables SwapBuffersWithBounds if it is supported.

switches.name: kEnableUnsafeSwiftShader
switches.comment: Allow usage of SwiftShader for WebGL

switches.name: kGpuNoContextLost
switches.comment: Inform Chrome that a GPU context will not be lost in power saving mode, screen saving mode, etc.  Note that this flag does not ensure that a GPU context will never be lost in any situations, say, a GPU reset.

switches.name: kOverrideUseSoftwareGLForTests
switches.comment: Forces the use of software GL instead of hardware gpu for tests.

switches.name: kSwapChainFormatNV12
switches.comment: Swap chain formats for direct composition SDR video overlays.

switches.name: kTestGLLib
switches.comment: Flag used for Linux tests: for desktop GL bindings, try to load this GL library first, but fall back to regular library if loading fails.

switches.name: kTintDcLayer
switches.comment: Tint `SwapChainPresenter` with the following colors: - Decode swap chain: blue - VP blit: magenta - VP blit w/ staging texture: orange - MF proxy surface: green This is similar to `HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\DWM` `OverlayTestMode=1` in DWM, but to help understand `SwapChainPresenter` state.

switches.name: kUseANGLE
switches.comment: Select which ANGLE backend to use. Options are: default: Attempts several ANGLE renderers until one successfully initializes, varying ES support by platform. d3d9: Legacy D3D9 renderer, ES2 only. d3d11: D3D11 renderer, ES2 and ES3. warp: D3D11 renderer using software rasterization, ES2 and ES3. gl: Desktop GL renderer, ES2 and ES3. gles: GLES renderer, ES2 and ES3.

switches.name: kUseAdapterLuid
switches.comment: Initialize the GPU process using the adapter with the specified LUID. This is only used on Windows, as LUID is a Windows specific structure.

switches.name: kUseCmdDecoder
switches.comment: Use the Pass-through command decoder, skipping all validation and state tracking. Switch lives in ui/gl because it affects the GL binding initialization on platforms that would otherwise not default to using EGL bindings.

switches.name: kUseGL
switches.comment: Select which implementation of GL the GPU process should use. Options are: desktop: whatever desktop OpenGL the user has installed (Linux and Mac default). egl: whatever EGL / GLES2 the user has installed (Windows default - actually ANGLE). swiftshader: The SwiftShader software renderer.

switches.name: kUseGpuInTests
switches.comment: Use hardware gpu, if available, for tests.

switches.name: kDisableExplicitDmaFences
switches.comment: Disable explicit DMA-fences

switches.name: kDisableWaylandIme
switches.comment: Disable wayland input method editor.

switches.name: kEnableWaylandIme
switches.comment: Try to enable wayland input method editor.

switches.name: kOzoneDumpFile
switches.comment: Specify location for image dumps.

switches.name: kOzoneOverrideScreenSize
switches.comment: Specifies ozone screen size.

switches.name: kOzonePlatform
switches.comment: Specify ozone platform implementation to use.

switches.name: kRenderNodeOverride
switches.comment: Allows explicitly picking a DRM render node to create gbm_device for rendering.

switches.name: kUseWaylandExplicitGrab
switches.comment: Use explicit grab when opening popup windows. See https://crbug.com/1220274

switches.name: kWaylandTextInputVersion
switches.comment: Specify wayland text-input protocol version. Defaults to "1" for text-input-v1. Can specify value "3" for experimental text-input-v3 support.

switches.name: kDisableInputEventActivationProtectionForTesting
switches.comment: Disables the disregarding of potentially unintended input events such as button clicks that happen instantly after the button is shown. Use this for integration tests that do automated clicks etc.

switches.name: kDrawViewBoundsRects
switches.comment: Draws a semitransparent red rect to indicate the bounds of each view. Also, draws a blue semitransparent rect when GetContentBounds() differs from GetLocalBounds().

switches.name: kViewStackTraces
switches.comment: Captures stack traces on View construction to provide better debug info.

switches.name: kWindowAnimationsDisabled
switches.comment: If present animations are disabled.
